aether_legacy.title.aether_legacy.valkyrie_queen.name: the Valkyrie Queen
aether_legacy.title.aether_legacy.sun_spirit.name: the Sun Spirit
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aechor_petal: The petal of an Aechor Plant, they have a sweet aroma to them. These are a Moa's favorite food, and can be used to feed baby Moas.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aerogel: The result of the Aether's unique climate and lava combining. It can be crafted into various decorative blocks and is blast resistant.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aerogel_slab: Crafted from Aerogel. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aerogel_stairs: Crafted from Aerogel. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aerogel_wall: Crafted from Aerogel. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aether_dirt: A pale dirt. It can be found in the Aether, and can also be used to grow the native trees. It can grow into grass with enough light.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aether_grass: Grass found in the Aether dimension. It can be used to grow the trees native to the Aether. It is much more pale than normal Grass.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aether_portal: I'm sad you had to cheat that in to check what it does. ~Kino
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.agility_cape: A slightly rare cape, it can be seen in Bronze and Silver Dungeons. It makes the wearer's legs stronger, therefore they can walk up blocks instantly.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.ambrosium_ore: The most common ore in the Aether. The drops can be doubled with Skyroot tools.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.ambrosium_shard: Aether's coal equivalent, they have a healing property when eaten, and restore a small amount of health.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.ambrosium_torch: The main light source for the Aether, made with a Skyroot Stick and Ambrosium.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.angelic_slab: Crafted from Angelic Stone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.angelic_stone: Angelic Stone is the main block that makes up Silver Dungeons. There is a chance some of them can be traps when generated in dungeons, but you cannot collect them as traps. It is unbreakable until you have defeated the boss, but it's worth it for that block.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.angelic_wall: Crafted from Angelic Stone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.angelic_stairs: Crafted from Angelic Stone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.berry_bush: These bushes can be found all over the Aether. They provide Blue Berries when broken, and then turn into bare stems. If placed on Enchanted Aether Grass the drops are doubled.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.berry_bush_stem: This is the result of harvesting the Blue Berries from a Berry Bush. It can take some time for them to grow back.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.black_moa_egg: An Egg laid by a Black Moa. Hatching this provides a Black Moa with 8 mid-air jumps, the best and most rare one!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.blue_aercloud: A pale blue cloud found close to the ground. It has very bouncy properties, and can help you reach high places.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.blue_berry: Harvested from Berry Bushes, this is the most common food source in the Aether. It has very weak hunger restoration. You can enchant these in an Altar for much better hunger restoration.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.blue_cape: A Blue Cape that has a silky feeling to it. It's crafted using Blue Wool.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.blue_moa_egg: An Egg laid by a Blue Moa. Hatching this provides a Blue Moa with 3 mid-air jumps. The most common Moa.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.candy_cane: Found in presents under Holiday trees! They can be used to repair Candy Cane swords, and are a very tasty treat.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.candy_cane_sword: A sword made from decorative candy. Randomly drops Candy Canes when used. These are dropped from presents that are under Holiday Trees.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.carved_slab: Crafted from Carved Stone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.carved_stairs: Crafted from Sentry Stone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.carved_stone: The Stone found in Bronze Dungeons. This stone has a gray color to it, and can be mined as a decorative block.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.carved_wall: Crafted from Carved Stone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.chain_gloves: A very rare part of chain armor, it is needed to complete the Chain Armor set.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.chest_mimic: It may look like a normal chest, but it really isn't. As soon as you right click on it, a chest mimic will pop out! These appear in Bronze and Silver dungeons.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.cloud_staff: A staff with a light and fluffy top. It summons small Cloud Sentries to fight next to the user for a short period of time by shooting large Iceballs.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.cold_aercloud: A cold cloud found in the skies of the Aether. It can be used to make Parachutes, and break drops that would otherwise be very dangerous.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.cold_parachute: A quickly made parachute. It's fluffy to the touch and is made from Cold Aerclouds. It has one use.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.crystal_fruit_leaves: Crystal Leaves that are home to White Apples.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.crystal_leaves: Leaves that come from Crystal Trees, they generate on floating islands. Sometimes they have fruit on them, which can cure poison.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.decorated_holiday_lea: Holiday Leaves that have been decorated with lovely little baubles for extra holiday cheer!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dart_enchanted: The ammo for Enchanted Dart Shooters. This is the strongest of the darts, made by enchanting Golden Darts.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dart_golden: The ammo for Golden Dart Shooters. Crafted with Skyroot Sticks and Golden Amber, enchanting these converts them to Enchanted Darts.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dart_poison: The ammo for Poison Dart Shooters, these are made by infecting Golden Darts with poison!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dart_shooter_enchante: A Dart Shooter which shoots Enchanted Darts, the strongest one!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dart_shooter_golden: A Dart Shooter which shoots Golden Darts, enchanting it on an Altar improves it's attack power!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dart_shooter_poison: A Dart Shooter which shoots Poison Darts. Shooting this at something infects them with a deadly poison!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.diamond_gloves: Part of the Diamond Armor set, it is needed to complete the Diamond Armor set.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dungeon_key_bronze: A dull key that is dropped from the Slider after being defeated. You can use it to claim the treasure you earned!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dungeon_key_golden: A key that has a shiny finish. It is dropped by the Sun Spirit after you defeat him. You can use it to claim the legendary treasure in the back room!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dungeon_key_platinum: Only the true holder knows what unlocks with this key.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.dungeon_key_silver: A reflective key that is given to you by the Valkyrie Queen after defeating her. Use it to claim the treasure she left behind!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.enchanted_aether_gras: Aether Grass enchanted which allows for increasing harvest rates of Blue Berries.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.enchanted_blueberry: An excellent food source, it tastes quite good and restores a massive amount of hunger.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.enchanted_gravitite: After putting Gravitite Ore into an Altar and enchanting it, you get Enchanted Gravitite. This can be made into Gravitite Tools and Armor. When powered with a Redstone signal, Enchanted Gravitite Blocks will float into the air, similarly to Gravitite Ore.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.enchanter: Used to enchant items and repair armor. They are powered by Ambrosium Shards. The enchanting process can take some time, but if you place an Enchanted Gravitite block under it, the process is sped up by a huge amount.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.flaming_sword: An ancient sword which flames its foes to a burning crisp. It almost hurts to touch! Using this on animals can make them drop cooked meat!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.freezer: You can freeze various items using this, such as Aerclouds, or Water Buckets. It's source of power is Icestone. You can speed up the freezing process by placing an Icestone under the Freezer.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.ginger_bread_man: Found in presents under Holiday trees, these are the most common of Christmas items. They are very abundant when dropped from presents.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_aercloud: A golden cloud found in small quantities, higher in the air than normal. The properties are similar to Cold Aerclouds, but the Parachutes they produce have much more durability.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_amber: These round golden orbs can be obtained by mining Golden Oak Logs with a Gravitite Axe. Their main purpose is to craft Golden Darts, and Dart Shooters.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_feather: A fluffy feather found in Silver Dungeons. When worn, the wearer becomes lighter than air and can descend slowly.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_gloves: Part of the Golden Armor set, it is needed to complete the Gold Armor set.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_oak_leaves: These golden Leaves generate with Golden Oak trees. They spawn golden particles in a radius of 5 blocks. They yield Golden Oak Saplings when decayed.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_oak_log: Skyroot Log which contains Golden Amber inside. When broken with an Axe they drop Skyroot Logs, and if the Axe is Gravitite, they will drop Golden Amber.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_oak_sapling: These large saplings when planted will grow into huge Golden Oak trees! You can use Bone Meal to speed up the process.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_parachute: The best parachute in the Aether. It has 20 uses and is made with Golden Aerclouds.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_pendant: An aesthetic accessory made of gold.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.golden_ring: An aesthetic accessory made of gold.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_axe: Part of Aether's best tool tier, this Axe not only can make wood blocks float, but it can mine Golden Oak logs for Golden Amber!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_boots: Part of Aether's best armor set, when the full set is worn, you get an extra high jump!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_chestplate: Part of Aether's best armor set, when the full set is worn, you get an extra high jump!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_gloves: Part of Aether's best armor set, needed to complete the Gravitite set.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_helmet: Part of Aether's best armor set, when the full set is worn, you get an extra high jump!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_leggings: Part of Aether's best armor set, when the full set is worn, you get an extra high jump!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_ore: This is Aether's rarest ore. It has floating properties and will float upward when there is nothing above it. These can be Enchanted into Enchanted Gravitite Blocks.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_pickaxe: Part of Aether's best tool tier, when mining with this powerful tool, you can right-click on any stone block and it will levitate into the air! You can mine any ore with this Pickaxe.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_shovel: Part of Aether's best tool tier, this shovel has the special ability to make dirt blocks, or sand levitate! When combined with enchantments such as Efficiency, it will instantly break Aether Dirt!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_sword: Part of Aether's best tool tier, when attacking with this powerful weapon, anything you hit will be flung into the air, causing lots of damage! Use this to your advantage, as it works even while your sword is cooling down!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.green_leaves: These leaves generate with Skyroot Trees. They can drop Skyroot Saplings when decaying.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gummy_swet_blue: A sweet smelling gummy, it can be found in random chests in Bronze and Silver dungeons. It restores the player’s hunger to full. Very useful for boss fights.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.gummy_swet_golden: A sour tasting gummy, it can be found in random chests in Bronze and Silver dungeons. It restores the player’s hunger to full. Very useful for boss fights.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.healing_stone: Obtained from enchanting Holystone, it can be used as a reliable healing source, providing Regeneration. It has a surprisingly juicy flavor.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.hellfire_slab: Crafted from Hellfire Stone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.hellfire_stone: A warm, red stone that makes up 90%% of Gold Dungeon interior. It cannot be destroyed until the Sun Spirit is defeated.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.hellfire_wall: Crafted from Hellfire Stone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.hellfire_stairs: Crafted from Hellfire Stone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holiday_leaves: Leaves on Christmas trees! It snows near them, and there is always presents nearby!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holy_sword: An ancient sword which does heavy amounts of damage to undead foes. A perfect weapon for traversing the Overworld.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone: The Aether's native rock. It can be used in various ways such as creating tools, construction, as well being able to be crafted into Holystone Bricks.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_axe: One of Aether's stone tools, it mines faster than Skyroot Tools, as well as dropping random Ambrosium Shards.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_brick: Used as a building material native to the Aether. It is made from Holystone and is more sturdy than it too.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_brick_slab: Crafted from Holystone Bricks. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_brick_stair: Crafted from Holystone Bricks. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_brick_wall: Crafted from Holystone Bricks. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_pickaxe: One of Aether's stone tools, it can mine Zanite, and will randomly drop Ambrosium Shards while mining.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_shovel: One of Aether's stone tools, it can mine Quicksoil, and all other blocks a Stone Shovel can mine, except it drops random Ambrosium Shards.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_slab: Crafted from Holystone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_stairs: Crafted from Holystone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_sword: One of Aether's stone tools, it can drop Ambrosium Shards at random while attacking.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_wall: Crafted from Holystone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.ice_pendant: A pendant which allows you to freeze water, and lava when walked on.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.ice_ring: A ring which allows you to freeze water, and lava when walked on.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.icestone: Icestone is a common ore that can be used as fuel for a Freezer. It can be used to freeze nearby liquids such as Lava and Water.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.incubator: Used to incubate Moa's. You use Ambrosium Torches for the fuel. The process can take quite some time, but it is worth the wait once your Moa of choice hatches!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.invisibility_cape: A cloak that makes the wearer completely invisible! Since mobs cannot see you, they cannot attack you. Sneak up on your enemies with it!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.iron_bubble: A common dungeon loot. It allows for the wearer to breathe underwater for a longer time than normal.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.iron_gloves: Part of the Iron Armor set, it is needed to complete the Iron Armor set.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.iron_pendant: An aesthetic accessory made of iron.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.iron_ring: An aesthetic accessory made of iron.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.jeb_hammer: A mysterious hammer that shoots projectiles out of it. At one point it vanished from existence. It's said this was actually Jeb's hammer at one point.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.leather_gloves: Dyeable gloves to match your leather tunic! This is needed to complete the Leather armor set.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.life_shard: A very rare item found in Gold Dungeons. Using this will give you an extra permanent heart! The feeling of using it is very strange, and hard to describe.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.light_angelic_stone: The Light version of Angelic Stone. It is less common than Angelic Stone, but it looks really nice as a decorative block.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.light_hellfire_stone: The Light version of Hellfire Stone. It can be found in Gold Dungeons along with Hellfire stone, but like it's counterpart, it cannot be collected until the boss is defeated.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.lightning_knife: Small knives that when thrown, summon lightning bolts where they land.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.lightning_sword: An ancient sword which summons lightning to its foes.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.lore_book: A large book containing many lore entries written by the wise Lorist. It describes every object in detail.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.mossy_holystone: A more aged Holystone, it is found near dungeons, and has pale colored vines growing on it, very decorative.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.mossy_holystone_slab: Crafted from Mossy Holystone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.mossy_holystone_stair: Crafted from Mossy Holystone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.mossy_holystone_wall: Crafted from Mossy Holystone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.nature_staff: A staff that can allow for commanding tamed Moas. It can allow them to sit on the ground.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_boots: Found in Silver Dungeons, this armor allows for water walking. The full set is a much better replacement for the Depth Strider enchantment.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_chestplate: Found in Silver Dungeons, this armor allows for water walking. Combined with an Iron Bubble, this armor set is super useful for defeating underwater temples.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_gloves: Found in Silver Dungeons, these gloves are requires to complete the Neptune Armor set, which allows for underwater walking.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_helmet: Found in Silver Dungeons, this armor allows for water walking. Combined with an Iron Bubble, this armor set is super useful for defeating underwater temples.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_leggings: Found in Silver Dungeons, this armor allows for water walking. Combined with an Iron Bubble, this armor set is super useful for defeating underwater temples.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.notch_hammer: A mighty hammer which shoots heavy projectiles at mobs. It's said that Notch actually held this hammer.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_boots: A super powerful armor, more powerful than Diamond, this armor is only obtainable by standing in water while wearing Phoenix Armor, converting it to Obsidian.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_chestplate: A super powerful armor, more powerful than Diamond, this armor is only obtainable by standing in water while wearing Phoenix Armor, converting it to Obsidian.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_gloves: Needed to complete the Obsidian Armor set, you can convert Phoenix Gloves into Obsidian by standing in water while wearing them.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_helmet: A super powerful armor, more powerful than Diamond, this armor is only obtainable by standing in water while wearing Phoenix Armor, converting it to Obsidian.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_leggings: A super powerful armor, more powerful than Diamond, this armor is only obtainable by standing in water while wearing Phoenix Armor, converting it to Obsidian.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.orange_moa_egg: An Egg laid by an Orange Moa. Hatching this provides an Orange Moa with 2 mid-air jumps, but extreme speed. This Moa is quite common.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_boots: Found in Gold Dungeons, when fully worn, this armor set allows for Fire Resistance, you can swim in Lava as well. Be careful when standing in water, as it will turn into Obsidian armor.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_bow: Found as a dungeon loot, this bow is very heated, and can shoot flaming arrows! It's warm to the touch.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_chestplate: Found in Gold Dungeons, when fully worn, this armor set allows for Fire Resistance, you can swim in Lava as well. Be careful when standing in water, as it will turn into Obsidian armor.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_gloves: Found in Gold Dungeons, these gloves are required to finish the Phoenix Armor set, and are needed to convert the full set into Obsidian too.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_helmet: Found in Gold Dungeons, when fully worn, this armor set allows for Fire Resistance, you can swim in Lava as well. Be careful when standing in water, as it will turn into Obsidian armor.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_leggings: Found in Gold Dungeons, when fully worn, this armor set allows for Fire Resistance, you can swim in Lava as well. Be careful when standing in water, as it will turn into Obsidian armor.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.pig_slayer: Kills any Pig type mobs with nothing with a single blow. But why would you want to do that? Great for traversing the Nether.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.pillar: The main part of the Silver Dungeon's decorative pillars, they spawn all around the dungeon, and are excellent for building.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.pillar_top: The top of the Silver Dungeon's decorative pillars, they look excellent, and are great for building.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.pink_aercloud: A very soft cloud that is pink. It has natural healing properties, healing anyone's wounds when stepped in.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.present: A wonderful holiday gift, open it for a surprise! Be careful, as there's a chance you could get ssssssurprised!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.purple_flower: These pretty violet flowers can be found in large numbers around the Aether. They can be crafted into purple dye when placed into a Crafting Table.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.quicksoil: A silky sand with extremely slippery properties. It can be seen floating on the side of Aether islands. Be careful around it, or you'll fall off.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.quicksoil_glass: After enchanting Quicksoil you can get this tinted glass. It is slightly slippery and makes a for a great window.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.red_cape: A rough feeling cape that is crafted using Red Wool.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.regeneration_stone: A treasure found in Silver Dungeons. This stone makes the wearer feel healthy, and heals their wounds. The effects can stack with other Regeneration Stones.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.repulsion_shield: A shield that protects the user from most projectiles. It will reflect the projectile back at the thrower and cause damage to them. Each time a projectile is reflected the shield will be damaged.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.sentry_boots: Found in Bronze Dungeons, these boots protect you from fall damage, allowing you to fall from great heights.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.sentry_stone: The Light version of Carved Stone, also found in Bronze Dungeons.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_axe: One of Aether's wooden tools, it can be used to double Skyroot Log drops. Simple but useful for beginners.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bed_item: Crafted with cyan wool and skyroot planks. You can only sleep at night to skip night time, but during the day you can set your respawn point in the Aether. Cannot sleep while mobs are nearby.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bookshelf: Crafted from Skyroot Planks and Books. Bookshelves can be used to enhance the enchanting capabilities of an enchanting table.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_empty: A hand crafted bucket, used to contain Aechor poison, a nice Remedy or even just plain Water!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_milk: A bucket full of fresh Milk, drink it to heal potion effects.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_poison: A Skyroot Bucket that has been filled with a deadly poison. Better not drink it! It can be used to craft Poison Darts and Dart Shooters. Enchant it to cure the poison in it.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_remedy: A Skyroot Bucket containing a soothing remedy. It has a strong smell. Drinking this cures deadly poison, and prevents it for a short time.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_water: A Skyroot Bucket that is filled to the brim with Water.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_fence: Crafted from Skyroot planks and Sticks. Great for keeping your livestock safe from wandering predators!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_fence_gate: Crafted from Sticks and Skyroot planks. Gives a homely entrance and exit to your precious enclosures.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_log: These spawn with Skyroot Trees. They can be double dropped with Skyroot Axes. When put in a crafting table they will provide 4 Skyroot Planks.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_pickaxe: One of Aether's wooden tools, when mining Holystone or Ambrosium ore, it will double the drops. This is even better when combined with an enchantment such as Fortune when mining Ambrosium Shards!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_plank: Skyroot Planks can be made into various tools, blocks and items. They are crafted from Skyroot Logs, and make a great building material.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_sapling: These small green saplings will grow into Skyroot Trees. They can be grown faster with Bone Meal.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_shovel: One of Aether's wooden tools, it doubles Aether dirt and Quicksoil drops.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_slab: Crafted from Skyroot. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_stairs: Crafted from Skyroot Planks. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_stick: Crafted from Skyroot Planks. Used to create various aether tools and items. Nothing else too special about it.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_sword: One of Aether's wooden tools, it has a low amount of durability, and doubles mob drops. It makes an excellent food collected when combined with enchantments such as Looting and Fire Aspect.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.sun_altar: An Altar containing the power to control the Sun itself! It is dropped by the Sun Spirit after you defeat him. Use it to control the time of day.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.swet_cape: A common cape that is found in Bronze Dungeons. It allows for the wearer to ride Swets, as they become friendly when they see someone wearing it.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.swetty_ball: A gooey orb that is dropped from Blue Swets. It can be used to fertilize soils. Another use is to put it alongside string to make a lead.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.treasure_chest: A treasure chest, these are found after defeating a Bronze, Silver or Gold dungeon. Any of the keys can open these, and the specific dungeon's loot will pop out.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_axe: A tool unique to the Silver Dungeon, This Axe has a very far reach, and very high attack power, you can use this to your advantage, but be warned, the attack cooldown is very high on this.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_boots: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon, when fully worn, you are granted temporary flight. Quite useful for getting to high places.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_cape: A rare cape that is found in Silver Dungeons. When worn, the wearer becomes lighter than air and can descend slowly.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_chestplate: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon, when fully worn, you are granted temporary flight. Quite useful for getting to high places.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_gloves: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon. The gloves are needed to complete the armor set, which grants temporary flight.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_helmet: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon, when fully worn, you are granted temporary flight. Quite useful for getting to high places.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_lance: A tool unique to the Silver Dungeon, this long range weapon is very good for defeating Zephyrs, and Valkyrie Queens.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_leggings: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon, when fully worn, you are granted temporary flight. Quite useful for getting to high places.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_pickaxe: A tool unique to the Silver Dungeon, this pickaxe is very useful when it comes to mining blocks from under islands, as it has a very far reach, almost double the normal reach! It is also quite useful for fighting the Slider.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_shovel: A tool unique to the Silver Dungeon, this shovel can help you reach Quicksoil from a safer distance, quite useful wouldn't you say?
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.vampire_blade: A mysterious sword that has life-stealing abilities. Holding it just makes you feel creepily empty...
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.victory_medal: Proof of defeating a lesser Valkyrie. Use these to prove to the Queen you are worthy enough to fight her!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.white_apple: One of the only known cures for the Aether's deadly poison. You can find them on Crystal Trees.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.white_cape: A light and fluffy cape that is made from White Wool.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.white_flower: These extremely good smelling roses can make great gifts to a friend or loved one. They spawn in large groups around the Aether.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.white_moa_egg: An Egg laid by a White Moa. Hatching this provides a White Moa with 4 mid-air jumps. This Moa is decently rare.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.yellow_cape: A bright Yellow Cape that is crafted using Yellow Wool.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_axe: One of Aether's mid-tier tools, you can mine wood faster than stone, and it will get even faster as the tool is worn down.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_block: A block of compacted Zanite Gemstones. They can power beacons, and just have a sleek look to them.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_boots: Part of the Zanite Armor set, the protection it grants increases as the durability decreases.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_chestplate: Part of the Zanite Armor set, the protection it grants increases as the durability decreases.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_gemstone: Aether's version of Iron. These shiny purple gems can be made into tools and armor, that increase in strength when used.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_gloves: Part of the Zanite Armor set, it is needed to complete the Zanite Armor set.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_helmet: Part of the Zanite Armor set, the protection it grants increases as the durability decreases.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_leggings: Part of the Zanite Armor set, the protection it grants increases as the durability decreases.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_ore: A slightly rare ore that drops Zanite Gemstones when broken with Stone tools.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_pendant: A pendant which allows you to mine faster. It doesn't last for long, so use it wisely!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_pickaxe: One of Aether's mid-tier tools, it mines what Iron can, except as it's durability decreases, it gets faster. Be careful though, as when it's repaired it will be as slow as before!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_ring: A ring which allows you to mine faster. It doesn't last for long, so use it wisely!
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_shovel: One of Aether's mid-tier tools, as you mine dirt and Quicksoil, the durability will decrease, and get faster. If you wait long enough it will start to break blocks instantly! Be careful repairing it, as it will be slower when there is more durability.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_sword: One of Aether's mid-tier tools, the attack damage on this sword starts at wood level, and will get to Diamond level when it's durability is low.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.aether_tune: A music disc that plays Aether Tune by Noisestorm.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.ascending_dawn: A music disc that plays Ascending Dawn by Emile van Krieken.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.legacy: A music disc that plays Legacy by xJonL.
aether_legacy.lore.aether_legacy.welcoming_skies: A music disc that plays Welcoming Skies by Voyed.

Offer a Dread Fragment, a Dreadstone, an Abyssalnite Stone, a Chunk of Abyssalnite, a Dreaded Chunk of Abyssalnite, a piece of Rotten Flesh, a Dreaded Shard of Abyssalnite and an Abyssalnite Ingot.

abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.yogsothothStatue.desc: A Yog-Sothoth Statue is created by infusing a Monolith Stone with Omothol Shoggoth Flesh, an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence and an Omothol Essence.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.shubniggurathStatue.desc: A Shub-Niggurath Statue is created by infusing a Monolith Stone with Shadow Shoggoth Flesh, an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence and an Omothol Essence.

abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.epOWupgrade.desc: An Overworld Energy Pedestal is created by infusing an Energy Pedestal with Cobblestone, Darkstone Cobblestone, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.epAWupgrade.desc: An Abyssal Wasteland Energy Pedestal is created by infusing an Overworld Energy Pedestal with Abyssal Stone Bricks, Coralium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.epDLupgrade.desc: A Dreadlands Energy Pedestal is created by infusing an Abyssal Wasteland Energy Pedestal with Dreadstone Bricks, Abyssalnite Stone Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.epOMTupgrade.desc: An Omothol Energy Pedestal is created by infusing a Dreadlands Energy Pedestal with Ethaxium Bricks, Dark Ethaxium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.saOWupgrade.desc: An Overworld Sacrificial Altar is created by infusing a Sacrificial Altar with Cobblestone, Darkstone Cobblestone, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.saAWupgrade.desc: An Abyssal Wasteland Sacrificial Altar is created by infusing an Overworld Sacrificial Altar with Abyssal Stone Bricks, Coralium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.saDLupgrade.desc: A Dreadlands Sacrificial Altar is created by infusing an Abyssal Wasteland Sacrificial Altar with Dreadstone Bricks, Abyssalnite Stone Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.saOMTupgrade.desc: An Omothol Sacrificial is created by infusing a Dreadlands Sacrificial Altar with Ethaxium Bricks, Dark Ethaxium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.jzaharStaff.desc: A Staff of The Gatekeeper is created by infusing a Staff of Rending with an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence, an Omothol Essence, Eldritch Scales and Ethaxium Ingots.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.respawnJzahar.desc: If you in some way failed to obtain an Essence of The Gatekeeper, you can revert time and fight J'zahar again. Can only be performed at the Ritual Altar inside the Temple of J'zahar (X=4, Y=54, Z=85).
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.altarOfChagarothBottom.desc: An Altar of Cha'garoth (bottom) is created with Dreadstone. Dreadium Ingots, Asorah's Dreaded Gateway Key, Bones and a piece of Dread Cloth.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.altarOfChagarothTop.desc: An Altar of Cha'garoth (top) is created with Sticks, a Bucket, Dread Cloths and Dreadium Ingots.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.corEnchantment.desc: By combining an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, Abyssal Shoggoth Flesh, Refined Coralium Ingots, Coralium-plagued Flesh and a Book, you can enchant a weapon placed on the altar with the Coralium enchantment (if applicable).
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.dreEnchantment.desc: By combining a Dreadlands Essence, Dreaded Shoggoth Flesh, Dreadium Ingots, Dread Fragments and a Book, you can enchant a weapon placed on the altar with the Dread enchantment (if applicable).
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.weather.desc: By sacrificing 8 Feathers, you can control the weather of the Biome you're inside (provided it can rain there). If it's not raining, it will rain. If it's raining, it will start thundering. If it's thundering the rain and thunder will cease.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.interdimensionalcage.desc: An Interdimensional Cage is created by infusing a Shard of Oblivion with Iron Bars. It can use Potential Energy to capture Entities. The amount of PE required is determined by the Entity's metric volume (ratio: 100 PE/m³), so larger entities require more PE to capture. PE is only drained when you capture an Entity.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.ecolOWupgrade.desc: An Overworld Energy Collector is created by infusing an Energy Collector with Cobblestone, Darkstone Cobblestone, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.ecolAWupgrade.desc: An Abyssal Wasteland Energy Collector is created by infusing an Overworld Energy Collector with Abyssal Stone Bricks, Coralium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.ecolDLupgrade.desc: A Dreadlands Energy Collector is created by infusing an Abyssal Wasteland Energy Collector with Dreadstone Bricks, Abyssalnite Stone Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.

abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.sorDLupgrade.desc: A Dreadlands Staff of Rending is created by infusing an Abyssal Wasteland Staff of Rending with Dreadstone, Dread Fragment and and a Shadow Gem.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.sorOMTupgrade.desc: An Omothol Staff of Rending is created by infusing a Dreadlands Staff of Rending with Omothol Stone, Omothol Flesh and and a Shadow Gem.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.cleansing.desc: By presenting 8 random statues, a massive amount of energy and a living sacrifice, you revert the corruption of the Abyss from the surrounding area. With far too much power comes no responsibilities, what so ever. It purges the Darklands, restoring it to its pure Overworld state.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.corruption.desc: By presenting 4 random statues, 4 blocks of Darkstone, a large amount of energy and a living sacrifice, you summon powers from the Abyss to corrupt the surrounding area. Defile the Overworld's purity in order to bring forth the Darklands.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.resurrection.desc: By presenting crystallized compounds resembling the elements of life, a living sacrifice and a Name Tag with the name of a fallen companion, you resurrect it. The Crystal size scale with the companion (Shards for something the size of a Chicken, Clusters for a Horse, normal for anything inbetween). Life has limits, however.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.purging.desc: By presenting 4 Crystallized Calcium Clusters and a large amount of energy, you purge every trace of the Dread Plague (and the Dreadlands) from the area, putting a stop to it here (also kills nearby mobs). While it renders the area uninhabitable, no plagues will be able to spread here. Doesn't work in the Dreadlands.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.basicScroll.desc: A Basic Scroll is created with 4 Books
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.lesserScroll.desc: A Lesser Scroll is created with 2 Books, a Wasteland's Thorn and a Luminous Thistle
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.moderateScroll.desc: A Moderate Scroll is created with 2 Books, a Dread Fragment and a Dreaded Shard of Abyssalnite
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.massEnchantment.desc: By presesenting 8 Enchanted Books and an Item on the altar, all of the Enchantments will be combined and applied on the Item. You can use any combination of Enchantments, and all levels will be combined, so multiple instances of the same Enchantment can surpass the normal boundaries.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.curing.desc: By presenting 4 Dread Plague Antidotes, you cure the area of the Dread Plague and the Dreadlands, restoring what was there before. The closest non-dreadlands biome will take the place of the Dreadlands.
abyssalcraft.ac.ritual.spiritTablet.desc: A Spirit Tablet is created by infusing a Life Crystal with 4 Spirit Tablet Shards. It's a tool that allows you to move Items between Blocks by having the Items move on their own. Read more about it in the Omothol section of the book.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.lifedrain.desc: Siphon the lifeforce of your enemy to heal your wounds.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.entropy.desc: Draw energy straight from the ground as it crumbles to dust.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.mining.desc: Superheat the ground in a straight line, melting any stone and leaving all ores intact.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.graspofcthulhu.desc: Damages the target over time while holding them in place. The damage can never reduce the target to 0HP or less
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.invisibility.desc: Caster or target goes Invisible for 5 minutes.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.detachment.desc: Removes one piece of equipment from the target causing it to fall on the ground. Equipped item is chosen randomly from among its equipped/held items.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.stealvigor.desc: The target is temporarily weakened while the caster claims their strength.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.sirenssong.desc: By singing to a creature's very soul you encourage it to join your team. (Useless on Players.)
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.undeathtodust.desc: Instantly disintegrate one undead creature, leaving nothing behind.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.oozeremoval.desc: Disperses any Shoggoth Ooze in the vicinity of the caster.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.teleporthostiles.desc: By sacrificing the life of an innocent child, the dark ones are pushed away. Cast the spell while targeting an animal baby, and all mobs within 50 blocks will be teleported away from you.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.displayRoutes.desc: Reveals any active Item transport routes within 16 blocks of the caster.
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.toggleState.desc: Starts/stops the Item transportation of all blocks within a 16 block radius of the player (or the block they're looking at).
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.floating.desc: As long as you're casting the spell, you're as light as a feather, allowing you to walk on air. Who needs gravity anyways?
abyssalcraft.ac.spell.teleportHome: When cast, teleports you back to your spawn point from wherever you are (including other dimensions).
abyssalcraft.ac.structure.basic.blocks: 15x Monolith Stone;4x Monolith Stone Pillar;4x Statue (any)
abyssalcraft.ac.structure.archway.blocks: 6x Wall Block (any);4x Stair Block (any);6x Slab Block (any);1x Statue (any);1x Monolith Stone
abyssalcraft.ac.rending.shadowgem: Shadow Gems are made from harvesting Shadow Energy from living shadows.
abyssalcraft.ac.rending.essence_aw: Abyssal Wasteland Essences are made from harvesting Abyssal Wasteland Energy from Coralium entities.
abyssalcraft.ac.rending.essence_dl: Dreadlands Essences are made from harvesting Dreadlands Energy from Dread entities.
abyssalcraft.ac.rending.essence_omt: Omothol Essences are made from harvesting Omothol Energy from entities in Omothol.
abyssalcraft.key.staff_mode.desc: Change Staff of The Gatekeeper Mode
abyssalcraft.key.configurator_filter.desc: Open the Spirit Tablet Filter inventory
abyssalcraft.key.configurator_path.desc: Clear the path in the Spirit Tablet

thaumcraft.tc.lootbag: Click to open, or keep to trade.
thaumcraft.warp.text.2: A sudden and unnatural hunger consumes you.
thaumcraft.warp.text.hunger.1: Your hunger cannot be satisfied with normal food.
thaumcraft.warp.text.3: Strange whispers reveal secrets to you.
thaumcraft.warp.text.4: Your vision becomes strange and grim.
thaumcraft.warp.text.5: The light suddenly becomes overwhelmingly bright and burns your skin.
thaumcraft.warp.text.6: A thick fog appears from nowhere. Something stirs in its depths.
thaumcraft.warp.text.8: Surely there must be a way to stop these headaches?
thaumcraft.warp.text.9: You suddenly feel reluctant to break things.
thaumcraft.warp.text.11: What was that noise? Something is behind you.
thaumcraft.warp.text.13: Something is watching you. Maybe it is time to stop.
thaumcraft.warp.text.14: You have a moment of clarity.
thaumcraft.warp.text.15: Your stomach suddenly gurgles very strangely.
thaumcraft.warp.text.16: The faint sound of chanting can be heard nearby.
thaumcraft.tc.boss.crimson: A ruby portal opens nearby, heralding the arrival of the Crimson Cult. You must close the portal quickly!
thaumcraft.tc.boss.golem: A lone sentinel stands frozen in this room, but as energy starts crackling through its ancient frame, you know it will not stay frozen for long.
thaumcraft.tc.boss.warden: Black energy bubbles on the distant pedestal. Something is coming...
thaumcraft.tc.boss.taint: An organic rustling comes from the room beyond. The sound of something... wrong. Something growing...
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.deft: This golem has a great deal of manual dexterity and can perform tasks requiring precision and a delicate touch. Counters and countered by Clumsy.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.clumsy: This golem has almost no manual dexterity and can only perform simple tasks requiring basic interactions. Counters and countered by Deft.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.smart: This golem is nearly sentient, with superior reasoning and decision-making capabilities.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.wheeled: The golem propels itself using wheels. This gives it greater speed, but it is unable to jump or navigate steep slopes.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.light: The golem is lighter than average, which gives it increased speed and agility. Counters and countered by Heavy.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.heavy: The golem is heavier than average, which reduces its speed and agility. Counters and countered by Light.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.fragile: The golem is built with delicate components or weak materials that reduce its life total and armour rating. Counters and countered by Armored.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.armored: The golem is reinforced with additional material which increases its armor rating. Counters and countered by Fragile.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.repair: The golem repairs any damage suffered at more than double the normal rate.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.fighter: The golem is capable of taking hostile action against other entities.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.flyer: The golem is capable of flight, giving it greater mobility at the cost of speed.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.climber: Sheer cliffs do not deter this golem. It can easily scale them to get to its destination.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.scout: The golem has a greater visual range and can operate in a much wider area: 48 blocks away from its home location, instead of 32.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.fireproof: The golem is immune to fire damage.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.brutal: The golem inflicts greater melee damage in combat.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.breaker: The golem is capable of destroying most blocks with ease.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.hauler: Allows the golem to carry two stack of items instead of one.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.ranged: The golem can attack targets at range.
thaumcraft.golem.trait.text.blastproof: The golem is highly resistant to explosion damage.
thaumcraft.golem.material.text.wood: The golem is crafted from greatwood. It is light and agile, but not particularly sturdy.
thaumcraft.golem.material.text.iron: The golem is crafted from iron. It is sturdy and fireproof, but heavy.
thaumcraft.golem.material.text.brass: The golem is crafted from brass. It is not as sturdy as iron nor as resistant to fire. Normally brass is heavier than iron, but it allows for superior construction methods which results in a much lighter frame.
thaumcraft.golem.material.text.clay: The golem is crafted from baked clay. It is not a particularly sturdy material, but the resulting golem is fireproof and relatively light.
thaumcraft.golem.material.text.thaumium: The golem is crafted from thaumium. It shares many characteristics with iron, though it is sturdier and more resistant to damage.
thaumcraft.golem.material.text.void: The golem is crafted from void metal. Slightly softer than iron, this metal makes up for it by being lighter and able to repair itself.
thaumcraft.golem.head.text.basic: The default golem head. No particular strengths or weaknesses.
thaumcraft.golem.head.text.smart: This head contains an advanced biothaumic brain, giving the golem greater capabilities and the ability to learn.
thaumcraft.golem.head.text.smart_armored: The smart head enhanced with additional armor and padding.
thaumcraft.golem.head.text.scout: The basic clockwork head enhanced with improved biothaumic eyes.
thaumcraft.golem.head.text.smart_scout: Using both biothaumic eyes and brain, this head is the pinnacle of the biothaumic art.
thaumcraft.golem.arm.text.basic: The default golem arms and hands. No particular strengths or weaknesses.
thaumcraft.golem.arm.text.fine: These arms end in delicate and dexterous hands.
thaumcraft.golem.arm.text.claws: These arms end in a terrifying pair of razor sharp metal pincers. Comes with a built-in aggression module.
thaumcraft.golem.arm.text.breakers: These arms end in a pair of pneumatic, diamond tipped grinders.
thaumcraft.golem.arm.text.darts: These arms end in a pair of pneumatic dart launchers. The darts are magically created as they are needed. Comes with a built-in aggression module.
thaumcraft.golem.leg.text.walker: A pair of simple legs. No particular strengths or weaknesses.
thaumcraft.golem.leg.text.roller: A single wheel. Quite fast, but incapable of jumping or going up steep hills.
thaumcraft.golem.leg.text.climber: A pair of simple legs enhanced with crampons and other devices allowing for vertical ascent.
thaumcraft.golem.leg.text.flyer: A modified arcane levitator granting the golem the power of flight. Reduces speed by a third.
thaumcraft.golem.addon.text.fighter: Allows the golem to engage in combat.
thaumcraft.golem.addon.text.hauler: Allows the golem to carry two stack of items instead of one.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.AIR.text: Creates a blast of air that knocks things back, but causes only minor damage.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.EARTH.text: Hurls a blast of earthen shrapnel that causes significant damage and may break weaker blocks.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.FIRE.text: Hurls flame at your target and sets it alight.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.FROST.text: Throws chilling cold at your target, causing damage and freezing it. Freezes water and will slow down creatures.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.BREAK.text: Summons disruptive energy that breaks down most materials.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.CURSE.text: Summons the powers of entropy to harm and disrupt the targeted creature.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.FLUX.text: This effect conjures raw, unfocused vis that disrupts living (and dead) creatures. This energy cannot interact with inanimate objects, but it does bypass mundane armor.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.RIFT.text: Shifts matter into an alternate reality, creating temporary 'holes' through which you can travel.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.EXCHANGE.text: Swap one type of block in the world for another.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.HEAL.text: This effect heals living creatures and harms undead.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.TOUCH.text: Allows you to affect things you can touch, within roughly 4 blocks of the point of origin.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.PROJECTILE.text: Gathers the energy of the focus into a magical orb that you can throw like a projectile. This projectile travels slowly and is affected by gravity.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.BOLT.text: Hurl magic directly at your target as a concentrated bolt of energy. The effect is instantaneous, but the range is limited to 16 blocks.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.PLAN.text: Allows you to plan exactly which blocks will be affected.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.CLOUD.text: Creates a lingering cloud of magical energy that effects anything inside.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.MINE.text: Creates a mystical construct that detonates when a hostile entity passes nearby, releasing the effects upon it.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.SPELLBAT.text: Conjures a mystical bat that will hunt down enemies and inflict them with the focus's effects.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.SCATTER.text: Split a single trajectory into multiple random trajectories.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.SPLITTARGET.text: Split a single target into two weaker ones.
thaumcraft.thaumcraft.SPLITTRAJECTORY.text: Split a single trajectory into two weaker ones.
thaumcraft.golem.prop.lock: Only golems owned by seal owner can perform these tasks
thaumcraft.golem.prop.unlock: All golems can perform these tasks
thaumcraft.card.study.text: A large part of research is simply hitting the books and putting in the work. You study %1$s and gain 15 to 25 progress.
thaumcraft.card.reject.name: Reject %1$s findings
thaumcraft.card.reject.text: You come to the realization that %1$s is not vital to your current research. You will not gain any more progress in %1$s, or draw any cards related to that category, but your current progress will remain.
thaumcraft.card.experimentation.text: You perform some random experiments to see if something can be discovered. Gain 15 to 30 progress in a completely random category.
thaumcraft.card.analyze.text: By thoroughly analyzing observations you have made about %1$s you might be able to put together a theory based on the collected data. Lose 1 %1$s observation to gain 25 to 50 %1$s progress and 5 %2$s progress.
thaumcraft.card.rethink.text: You take a step back and reassess your findings. You get rid of invalid conclusions and proceed with fresh understanding. Lose 10 progress divided evenly between all current categories, but you regain 1 inspiration and gain a bonus draw.
thaumcraft.card.ponder.text: You carefully consider all you have learned so far. Gain 25 progress divided evenly between all current active categories and a bonus draw.
thaumcraft.card.notation.text: While making notes of your discoveries thus far you find some errors and correct them. You lose all your progress in %1$s, but most of the lost progress is added to %2$s.
thaumcraft.card.balance.text: A moment of revelation shows you the common links between all you have been studying. Your total progress is split evenly amongst all currently revealed and valid categories and an additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion.
thaumcraft.card.curio.text: While examining a curio often reveals some interesting information it is much better to study it as part of controlled research.
thaumcraft.card.inspired.text: Inspired by the progress you have made so far, your mind explores paths you have not considered before. You gain %1$s %2$s.
thaumcraft.card.enchantment.text: You study normal enchantment to see how it functions at a fundamental level. You are sure that is shares a lot in common with the enchantment methods used in Infusion and Artifice. You lose 5 experience levels, but will gain 15 to 20 progress in both Infusion and Auromancy.
thaumcraft.card.beacon.text: You believe that the beacon interacts in some way with the mystical aura. You carefully study this and while you cannot find anything concrete this time you have been inspired. You regain 2 inspiration, 1 bonus draw and an additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion.
thaumcraft.card.dragonegg.text: The aura around the egg swirls with strange and chaotic energies. Occasionally you glimpse strange order in the chaos.
thaumcraft.card.celestial.text: You take some of the celestial notes you have made and compare them for possible correlations with your primary research category. You gain 25 to 50 inspiration toward %1$s. You may gain other things as well...
thaumcraft.card.concentrate.text: Often much can be learned by concentrating a substance into its purest form. Attempt to concentrate some %1$s essentia. Gain 15 Alchemy and 1 bonus draw. There is also a chance you will gain 1 inspiration.
thaumcraft.card.reactions.text: Studying the reactions between two different types of vis should prove beneficial. You should study what happens when %1$s essentia reacts with %2$s essentia. Gain 25 Alchemy. There is also a chance you will gain 1 inspiration.
thaumcraft.card.synthesis.text: When essentia combines to form more complex forms a number of interesting and intricate reactions take place. You will learn much by combining %1$s essentia with %2$s essentia and then studying the resulting combination. Gain 40 Alchemy. There is also a chance you will gain 1 inspiration.
thaumcraft.card.measure.text: You take some time to make detailed measurements of various types of essentia and the potential vis they contain. Gain 15 Infusion progress and 1 bonus draw.
thaumcraft.card.channel.name: Channel %1$s Essentia
thaumcraft.card.channel.text: You set up a simple experiment to examine what happens when you channel %1$s during infusion. Gain 25 Infusion.
thaumcraft.card.infuse.text: By making assumptions on the results of infusing certain objects with essentia, and then testing those results valuable insight may be gained. You will learn much by combining %1$s essentia with %2$s and then studying the result. Gain %3$s Infusion.
thaumcraft.card.calibrate.text: You take some time to properly calibrate your instruments and tools. Gain 15 Artifice and a bonus draw.
thaumcraft.card.mindmatter.name: Mind over Matter
thaumcraft.card.mindmatter.text: You carefully examine and take apart some basic components in the hopes of finding new ways to assemble them into more complex creations. Gain %1$s Artifice.
thaumcraft.card.tinker.text: You start tinkering with some devices to find new ways of incorporating them into magical creations. Gain %1$s to %2$s Artifice.
thaumcraft.card.spellbinding.text: You bind various test enchantments to small pieces of leftover crystal. They have no practical purpose, but grant you invaluable knowledge. Lose up to 5 experience levels, but gain 5 Auromancy per level lost.
thaumcraft.card.awareness.text: You open yourself to the flows of vis around you. You gain a deeper understanding of how it works and the underlying nature of things, but this leaves you metaphysically vulnerable. Gain 20 Auromancy. There is a chance you gain Eldritch knowledge and Warp.
thaumcraft.card.focus.text: You focus your mind on the magical and spiritual energy around you, hoping to grow more attuned to its ebb and flow. Gain 15 Auromancy and a bonus draw.
thaumcraft.card.sculpting.text: You can hone your knowledge by creating simple and short-lived animated figurines. Gain 20 Golemancy and a bonus draw.
thaumcraft.card.scripting.text: A large part of Golemancy is creating intricate arcane texts to control your creations. By creating some test scripts you can further your understanding. Gain 25 Golemancy. This consumes additional paper and ink from the research table.
thaumcraft.card.synergy.text: At its root, Golemancy is a blend of Alchemy, Artifice and Infusion. Only by fully understanding how these three disciplines interact with each other will you be able to master Golemancy. Lose 15 points divided evenly between Alchemy, Artifice and Infusion to gain 30 Golemancy. An additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion.
thaumcraft.card.darkwhisper.text: The brain in a jar has been very talkative lately. It promises you ancient secrets for all your experience. Can you trust it?
thaumcraft.card.glyph.text: You study the ancient glyphs. What Eldritch secrets do they hold? You find the ancient language difficult to understand, but now and again some nugget of truth reveals itself to you.
thaumcraft.card.portal.name: Voices from Beyond
thaumcraft.card.portal.text: Bathed in the light of this strange portal you find strange thoughts invading your mind. Most are incomprehensible, but some fill your mind with strange inspirations.
thaumcraft.card.revelation.text: Studying the Eldritch is a dangerous pursuit, but the knowledge you can uncover is often worth it. You gain 30 Eldritch progress and 5 to 10 progress in a random category. You will also gain some temporary and normal Warp and an additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion.
thaumcraft.card.realization.text: While pondering the nature of the Eldritch you come to a sudden and shocking realization on the true nature of the universe. You gain 15 Eldritch progress and 5 to 10 progress in two random categories. You will also gain some temporary Warp. There is a chance you may gain some normal Warp as well.
thaumcraft.card.truth.text: You desperately try and find the truth behind the Eldritch and what it could mean for the world. You gain 10 to 25 Eldritch progress and a bonus draw. You will also gain some temporary Warp.
thaumcraft.got.crystals: Your fingers tingle strangely as you handle the crystal. What does that mean? Maybe some rest will inspire you.
thaumcraft.got.dream: You awaken from a strange dream. You quickly write it down before the memory fades.
thaumcraft.false.start: This feels like it should work, but something is missing...
thaumcraft.tc.taint_item_poison: A dissolving %s has infected you with Taint
thaumcraft.tc.handmirrorerror: Destination mirror is missing or misplaced. Link broken.
thaumcraft.tc.discoveryerror: To understand this you need to study %1$s.
thaumcraft.tc.addclue: §aYou have discovered something that could aid future research§0
thaumcraft.tc.unknownobject: Nothing new can be learned from this.
thaumcraft.tc.invtoolarge: Inventory too large. Only scanning first 100 items.
thaumcraft.tc.search.more: ...too many results found. Refine your search
thaumcraft.tc.need.research: Things that need to be discovered
thaumcraft.tc.need.craft: Items that need to be crafted
thaumcraft.tc.break.fly: Something disrupts your ability to fly.
thaumcraft.tc.boss.enrage: is enraged by your powerful blows.
thaumcraft.tc.notowned: This does not belong to you.
thaumcraft.tc.fluxevent.1: The nearby aura suddenly twists and warps, leaving your thoughts in a shambles.
thaumcraft.tc.fluxevent.2: The local aura momentarily becomes unstable, hampering your magical ability.
thaumcraft.tc.fluxevent.3: It seems that there is too much flux in the local aura!
thaumcraft.tc.celestial.fail.1: You have already studied that today.
thaumcraft.tc.celestial.fail.2: You are unable to take notes of your studies.
thaumcraft.tc.aspect.name: Aspects of Essentia
thaumcraft.got.deepdown: You have visited deep and dark depths and have learned much.
thaumcraft.got.uphigh: The world is spread out before you. Your perspective has been broadened.
thaumcraft.got.finddesert: You have visited the scorching desert.
thaumcraft.got.findocean: You have peered into the endless blue abyss.
thaumcraft.got.instability: You should study infusion instability further.
thaumcraft.got.projectile: You learn some more about projectiles.
thaumcraft.not.pechwand: You cannot fathom the workings of this yet.
thaumcraft.got.pechwand: Hmm, curious. You should investigate this further.
thaumcraft.got.onfire: You have felt the touch of flame.
thaumcraft.fail.crimsonrites: This book contains nothing but crazed ravings.
thaumcraft.research.METALPURIFICATION.stage.2: I have formulated an alchemical recipe to purify metal ores into native clusters, as I was hoping. As mentioned previously, smelting these produces twice the number of ingots than a regular piece of ore - this should help me avoid continually delving into the depths on mining expeditions. The recipe itself is versatile, and should work for many kinds of metal ore if I have access to them.

integrateddynamics.operator.operators.integrateddynamics.re: Recipe With Input and Output Ingredients
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.introductio: For too long, automation possibilities have been too limited. &1Integrated Dynamics&0 aims to be the go-to mod for automating your logic systems. It does this by providing an expressive immersive logic programming experience with hooks and support for most elements of &lMinecraft&r and its modifications.

Redstone circuits have always been a very basic, but workable and easily understandable method for automation. The basicness of redstone is however also an inconvenience. For automation networks with higher complexities, redstone circuits can become very large and consequently also difficult to manage. Furthermore, one small water-leak can cause major headaches to every redstoner.

The goal of this book is twofold. First, a &ltutorial&r is provided for learning the most important concepts behind this mod. Secondly, a detailed &lmanual&r of all elements and mechanisms are explained for players that are not not interested in the tutorial.

You can navigate through this book by clicking on the arrows at the bottom, shift clicking will flip through whole sections instead of single pages. At the start of large sections you will see a content table which will contain hyperlinks to its subsections for faster browsing. When you come across recipes, the items that are explained in this book are clickable as a fast reference to the section they are explained in. You will also notice a button at the top left of this book, which will take you to the section above your current one. The button at the top right corner will go back to the previously visited page each time when clicked.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.i: This part of the book contains several tutorials that will help you understand the basics of the mod. Furthermore, it will allow you to earn some &lrewards&r while accomplishing the achievements of each tutorial.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.m: To get started with this mod, you will need to find some &lMenril Trees&r which can most easily be found in &lMeneglin Biomes&r.

After that, you’ll need to craft a &lSqueezer&r and &lDrying Basin&r for processing &lMenril Wood&r. This can be done by placing a block of wood in the &lSqueezer&r and jumping on it until it's flat. Once that has been done, the &lMenril Resin&r will try to go to the two sides of the &lSqueezer&r. Next, place a &lDrying Basin&r next to the &lSqueezer&r to make it fill with the &lMenril Resin&r you just squeezed.
If you want to repeat the process, you can reset the &lSqueezer&r by applying a redstone pulse.

In the future, you will also be able to craft upgraded variants of these machines that are more easily automatable, but are more costly: the &lMechanical Squeezer&r and the &lMechanical Drying Basin&r.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.n: The main goal of this mod is for building control networks for automation. This is done using &lLogic Cables&r. Try making a network with ten of those cables.

The next step will be to craft some &lVariable Cards&r and &lVariable Transformers&r. &lVariable Cards&r are used to store references to values in the network. &lVariable Transformers&r are crafting elements for components that can be placed on &lLogic Cables&r for reading and writing these values.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.b: One of the methods for binding &lVariable Cards&r to certain values, is by reading in values from &lReaders&r. Let’s start by crafting some basic readers. After that, craft a &lDisplay Panel&r, which is useful for displaying the values of &lVariable Cards&r.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.a: As a simple example, let’s try reading in a redstone value and displaying it.
Do this by attaching a &lRedstone Reader&r to a &lLogic Cable&r in the world. Make sure that the reading is targeting something with a redstone value, like a &lRedstone Torch&r.

After that, right-click on the &lRedstone Reader&r to open the gui, after which you have to insert a &lVariable Card&r into the &6Integer&0 &lRedstone Value&r aspect, to bind the target’s redstone value to that &lVariable Card&r.
Next, place a &lDisplay Panel&r in the same network as the &lRedstone Reader&r, and insert your bound &lVariable Card&r to display it value.
As a next step, craft a &lRedstone Writer&r and let it write a maximal integer redstone value that was read by a Redstone Reader.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.l: While displaying values that originate from readers can be useful, things get really interesting when you start combining certain values with other values using &2Operators&0. All &2Operators&0 can be found in the &lLogic Programmer&r.
Start by crafting a &lLogic Programmer&r, which exists in both item and block-form. Open its gui to see the list of all &loperators&r.

Next, search for the &6Integer&0 operator, and click on it. This will open a window in which you should type a number. When you have done this, insert an empty &lVariable Card&r to bind that &6Integer&0 to the &lVariable Card&r. When you’re done, do that once more for another &6Integer&0.

Finally, search for the &lAddition&r operator and open it. This allows you to add two &eNumbers&0. Insert your two &6Integer&0 &lVariable Cards&r into these slots, and bind it to a new &lVariable Card&r.

As &1Integrated Dynamics&0 evaluates variables in a &olazy&r manner, this &lAddition&r &lVariable Card&r does not contain the addition of these &6Integers&0 directly, but the addition will only be performed when the value is needed in the network, based on the variable references. For this, the network has to be able to find these referenced &lVariable Card&r. For this, you will need to craft and place a &lVariable Store&r. Insert the two &6Integer&0 &lVariable Cards&r into this store to make them available to the network.
Finally, you can now connect a cable to the &lVariable Store&r, attach a &lDisplay Panel&r, and insert the &lAddition&r &lVariable Card&r to display the addition.
The &lLogic Programmer&r and &lVariable Stores&r are going to be your best friends when you want to do more complex automation.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.r: &oRecipes&r are a big part of &lMinecraft&r. That is why this mod offers first-class support for them via &8Recipe&0 values, and &lIngredients&r values to represent their input and output collections. In this tutorial, we will have a look at how recipes can be obtained and used.

The easiest way to obtain &8Recipes&0 is simply by reading it from a machine that can handle recipes. So let's start by reading all crafting recipes by placing a &lMachine Reader&r against a &lCrafting Table&r and reading the list of recipes.

If you want some more find-grained control over recipes, or if you are working with a machine that does not expose its recipes via the &lMachine Reader&r, you can visually create a &8Recipe&0 yourself in the &lLogic Programmer&r. Let's try creating a simple recipe, for example for crafting a &lChest&r.

In this last part of the tutorial, we'll take recipe reading one step further. Using the &lRecipe By Output&r aspect, we can retrieve an operator that, when applied to an &8Ingredients&0 instance, will return the first &8Recipe&0 that returns the given &8Ingredients&0 as output. We will use this to look up the recipe of a &lChest&r.

Let's start by creating an &8Ingredients&0 instance with a single &8Chest&0 in your &lLogic Programmer&r. Next, read the &lRecipe By Output&r aspect from a &lMachine Reader&r that targets a &lCrafting Table&r. After that, use the &oApply&r operator to apply your &lChest&r &8Ingredient&0 to the operator you got from the &lMachine Reader&r. Finally, insert the resulting variable into a &lDisplay Panel&r to see the &lChest&r's recipe. (Don't forget to insert all your used variables into a &lVariable Store&r).

Obviously, there is much more you can do with &8Recipes&0 and &8Ingredients&0. Have a look in the &lMachine Reader&r and &lLogic Programmer&r to find out what other advanced functionality is available to you.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.a: Now that you are familiar with basic logic, we can have a look at the more advanced network components: the &lMaterializer&r and the &lProxy&r.
As you may remember, the &lLogic Programmer&r allows you to create variables with &ostatic&r values, or you can create more complex variables based on &odynamic&r value evaluation.

The &lMaterializer&r can be used for converting a &odynamic&r value to a &ostatic&r one. This can be done by inserting the &odynamic&r &lVariable Card&r in the top slot of the &lMaterializer&r. Every &lVariable Card&r that is inserted into the left slot, will be set with the value the top variable has at that moment.

The &lProxy&r allows you to add an extra level of indirection for your variables. You may for example have a logic program that requires a &ostatic&r value in there. If at any point in the future, you want to change that value, you would have to rewrite your program, unless that value was &oproxied&r, in which case you would simply have to update the value in the &lProxy&r.
For this tutorial, create materialized and proxied &lVariable Cards&r.

As you may have noticed during the last tutorial, the &lLogic Programmer&r allows you to do way more than just adding numbers. In this tutorial, we’ll look into the more advanced datastructures and chaining of operators.
Let’s start by creating a static &7List&0 of the &6Integers&0 &61&0, &610&0 and &6100&0, and visualize it in a &lDisplay Panel&r.
&7Items&0 are one of the possible value types in this mod. Let’s make a static &7Item&0 &lVariable Card&r, dynamically retrieve the mod name from that item, and visualize it in a &lDisplay Panel&r.
Remember that you’ll have to use a &lVariable Store&r to store your referenced variable.

For the final, part of this tutorial, we’ll combine dynamic variables with operators. Attach an &lEntity Reader&r to a network, read the target &7Entity&0, retrieve the &7Block&0 the target &7Entity&0 is looking at, and visualize that &7Block&0 in a &lDisplay Panel&r.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.t: In &1Integrated Dynamics&0, &2Operators&0 are first-class citizens. Up until now, we have only used manually using the &lLogic Programmer&r, but in this tutorial, we’ll look into how they can be used in a more dynamic way, by storing &2Operators&0 in &lVariable Cards&r, and invoking them dynamically.

As a first step, go to the &lLogic Programmer&r, and create a new static &2Operator&0, by starting to type &oArithmetic Addition&r &2Operator&0 in the autocomplete dropdown-list and clicking it, and write it to a &lVariable Card&r. After that, create two &6Integer&0 variables. Next, find the &oApply&r operator, and apply the first &6Integer&0 to the &2Operator&0, which will &obind&r the first input argument of the addition &2Operator&0 to that &6Integer&0, and will output a new &2Operator&0 with one remaining input argument. Next, use the &oApply&r operator again to &obind&r the final input argument of the newly created &2Operator&0. Finally, use a &lDisplay Panel&r to visualize your dynamically invoked addition.

Next to applying &2Operators&0, there are a lot of other advanced &2Operator&0 operations. We’ll now look into using &2Operators&0 on &7Lists&0, more specifically the &oFilter&r &2Operator&0 that takes a &7List&0 and a &oPredicate&r (an &2Operator&0 with one input argument and a &9Boolean&0 output value). Start by creating a &7List&0 of the &6Integers&0 &61&0, &610&0 and &6100&0. Next, store the &oRelational Equals&r &2Operator&0 in a variable. Next, apply this operator on the &6Integer&0 &610&0. Next, use the &oFilter&r &2Operator&0 with your &7List&0 and the applied &2Operator&0. This will filter away all the items from the &7List&0 that return &9False&0 by applying them on the given operator, which in this case means that all elements that are not equal to &610&0 will be removed from the list. Visualize the result in a &lDisplay Panel&r.
There are plenty of other operations on &2Operators&0, such as combining &oPredicates&r, flipping &2Operator&0 arguments, and more operations on &7Lists&0.
integrateddynamics.info_book.integrateddynamics.tutorials.c: This final tutorial section contains several non-trivial challenges to show that you understand the basics of &1Integrated Dynamics&0. No further information will be given for each challenge, so good luck!
