bewitchment.research.MATSTUDCOLDIRON.title: Material Studies: Cold Iron
bewitchment.research.MATSTUDCOLDIRON.stage.1:
Like mundane iron, cold iron is quite sturdy but heavy.
However, unlike mundane iron, cold iron has several arcane properties, especially in terms of warding off demons and spirits.
bewitchment.golem.material.text.coldiron: The golem is crafted from cold iron. While it shares many identical characteristics with iron, it provides additional strength against demons and spirits.
bewitchment.research.MATSTUDSILVER.title: Material Studies: Silver
bewitchment.research.MATSTUDSILVER.stage.1:
Silver, being a precious metal, has been sought out for trading. However, silver is very soft and malleable, albeit not as malleable as gold.
Undead seem to be repulsed by silver, as do some other creatures of the night, however.
bewitchment.golem.material.text.silver: The golem is crafted from silver. This soft and malleable metal is also potent against the undead.
bewitchment.research.MATSTUDDRAGONSBLOOD.title: Material Studies: Dragon's Blood Resin
bewitchment.research.MATSTUDDRAGONSBLOOD.stage.1:
The resin from the Dragon's Blood tree has several interesting properties, especially its structure that greatly resembles that of human flesh.
While it may not be ideally suited as material for golems, working with it may be an interesting, if ghoulish, experience.
bewitchment.golem.material.text.dragonsblood: The golem is crafted from Dragon's Blood Resin. It's... a mess.
bewitchment.golem.trait.text.spiritual_ward: The golem is particularly strong against demons and spirits.

bewitchment.golem.trait.text.uncanny: This golem has an uncanny resemblance to human flesh. Even other mobs are slightly repulsed.

tconstruct.stat.head.durability.desc: The base-value for durability calculations.\nUsually an integral part to the overall durability of a tool.
tconstruct.stat.head.miningspeed.desc: How fast a tool with a tool head of this material can mine blocks.\nMay be influenced by other toolparts.
tconstruct.stat.head.harvestlevel.desc: What range of blocks a tool with a tool head of this material can mine.
tconstruct.stat.head.attack.desc: Base value for attack calculations.\nThe end result depends on the tool itself and the other components used.
tconstruct.stat.handle.modifier.desc: How suitable the tool material is as a handle.\nThe total durability of the tool will be multiplied by this.
tconstruct.stat.handle.durability.desc: How well the material can be held.\nTool durability will be changed by this amount.
tconstruct.stat.extra.durability.desc: How much durability this part contributes when used as an accessory.
tconstruct.stat.bow.drawspeed.desc: How fast you can draw the bow.
tconstruct.stat.bow.range.desc: How far the projectile can be propelled.
tconstruct.stat.bow.damage.desc: Bonus damage dealt on hit.\nThe force of the arrow.
tconstruct.stat.bowstring.modifier.desc: Tool durability will be multiplied by this.
tconstruct.stat.shaft.modifier.desc: Each arrow needs a suiting core. It determines how well it lasts.\nThe total ammo count of the tool will be multiplied by this.
tconstruct.stat.shaft.ammo.desc: How many arrows you can get out of it.\nThis much flat ammo will be added.
tconstruct.stat.fletching.accuracy.desc: How stable the flight path will be using this fletching.\nAffects the overall accuracy of the projectile.
tconstruct.stat.fletching.modifier.desc: How many arrows you can craft with this.\nProjectile ammo will be multiplied by this.
tconstruct.modifier.alien.desc: §oThe stats feel off...§r\n..as if they're changing! Maybe time will tell?
tconstruct.modifier.aquadynamic.desc: §oIt's getting wet in here!§r\nThe tool is unhindered by water and loves rainy evenings.
tconstruct.modifier.aridiculous.desc: §oTurn up the heat!§r\nThe tool works better in hotter environments.
tconstruct.modifier.autosmelt.desc: §oA furnace in tool form!§r\nHarvested blocks get smelted.
tconstruct.modifier.cheap.desc: §oMore bang for your buck!§r\nIncreases durability gained when repairing the tool.
tconstruct.modifier.cheapskate.desc: §oCheeky!§r\nStone is bad. Your tool has less durability.
tconstruct.modifier.coldblooded.desc: §oSavage!§r\nDeal increased damage to targets at full health.
tconstruct.modifier.crude.desc: §oArmor is for cowards!§r\nBonus damage against unarmored targets.
tconstruct.modifier.crumbling.desc: §oCrumble rumble rumble§r\nThe tool breaks soft blocks that don't need a tool faster.
tconstruct.modifier.dense.desc: §oHard...er.§r\nYour tool lasts longer when it has less durability.
tconstruct.modifier.duritos.desc: §oDoesn't taste as good as it sounds.§r\nYour tool lasts longer ...most of the time.
tconstruct.modifier.ecological.desc: §oGreen Power!§r\nRenewable resources are so good, they regenerate by themselves!
tconstruct.modifier.enderference.desc: §oAnti-Teleport!§r\nPrevents Endermen from teleporting around for a short time.
tconstruct.modifier.flammable.desc: §oCan't have enough fire!§r\nBlocking blocks fire damage and getting hit sets the attacker on fire.
tconstruct.modifier.hellish.desc: §oFrom down below!§r\nDeal bonus damage to non-Nether mobs.
tconstruct.modifier.insatiable.desc: §oDevour!§r\nDuring combat you deal more and more damage but also consume more and more durability.
tconstruct.modifier.jagged.desc: §oMoves like jagged!§r\nEvery point durability lost increases damage.
tconstruct.modifier.lightweight.desc: §oSwift like the wind!§r\nIncreases the overall speed of your tool when mining and attacking.
tconstruct.modifier.magnetic.desc: §oHow do they work?!§r\nHitting things attracts nearby things?!
tconstruct.modifier.momentum.desc: §oFaster, keep going!§r\nMining blocks increases your speed, as long as you keep going.
tconstruct.modifier.petramor.desc: §oSo much stone, must see it all!§r\nYour tool loves stone, it literally wants to absorb it (for durability).
tconstruct.modifier.prickly.desc: §oOuch!§r\nNobody is safe from those thorns, they always hurt.
tconstruct.modifier.sharp.desc: §oCan even cut words!§r\nHitting an enemy leaves them bleeding for a short time.
tconstruct.modifier.shocking.desc: §oBzzzzzt!§r\nRunning around, breaking blocks or hitting things charges your tool. Hitting an enemy discharges it, dealing damage and providing a speed boost. Mining a block discharges it, giving a mining speed boost.
tconstruct.modifier.spiky.desc: §o200% cooler with spikes!§r\nBlocking and getting hurt deals damage to the attacker.
tconstruct.modifier.splintering.desc: §oA souvenir for your enemies!§r\nHit them more to deal more damage.
tconstruct.modifier.splinters.desc: §oOuch!§r\nBe careful not to catch a splinter!
tconstruct.modifier.squeaky.desc: §oCute.§r\nYour tool is so soft and squeaky it gained silktouch, but deals no damage.
tconstruct.modifier.stiff.desc: §oUnmoving!§r\nBlocking reduces the damage taken even more.
tconstruct.modifier.stonebound.desc: §oYour tool absolutely loves stone!§r\nThe tool mines faster as it wears out, but does less damage.
tconstruct.modifier.superheat.desc: §oTurn up the heat!§r\nDeal bonus damage to enemies on fire.
tconstruct.modifier.unnatural.desc: §oAbomination!§r\nThe tool mines faster the higher its mining level is above the required one.
tconstruct.modifier.tasty.desc: §oOm Nom Nom§r\nSmells so good.. You'd rather eat your tool than starve.
tconstruct.modifier.writable.desc: §oIntellectual!§r\nMore words. More Modifiers. It's only logical!
tconstruct.modifier.breakable.desc: §oThis side up!§r\nProjectiles have a 50% chance to break on impact.
tconstruct.modifier.endspeed.desc: §oQuantum speed!§r\nProjectiles instantly travel to their destination.
tconstruct.modifier.freezing.desc: §oWinter is Coming§r\nSuccessful hits slow your target more and more.
tconstruct.modifier.hovering.desc: §oFree like the wind§r\nProjectiles move slower but don't mind gravity as much.
tconstruct.modifier.splitting.desc: §oTwo for one!§r\nThe sudden acceleration of releasing an arrow might cause it to split into two.
tconstruct.modifier.bane_of_arthopods.name: Bane of Arthropods
tconstruct.modifier.beheading.desc: §oOff with his head!§r\nEach level adds a 10% chance to get the enemies head on kill.
tconstruct.modifier.blasting.desc: §oKa-Boom!§r\nYou can break non-effective blocks like normal blocks, but they might get destroyed.
tconstruct.modifier.extratrait.desc: §oLike magic, but better!§r\nEmbossed with the power of %s, obtaining some of its traits.
tconstruct.modifier.fiery.desc: §oSo hot right now!§r\nBonus fire damage, sets your enemies on fire.
tconstruct.modifier.fins.desc: §oSomething's fishy...§r\nAttaching fins to the projectiles makes them travel like normal underwater.
tconstruct.modifier.fortify.desc: §oHarder, better, faster, stronger!§r\nMining level increased to the same level as %s.
tconstruct.modifier.glowing.desc: §oShine bright§r\nWhenever it gets too dark your tool sacrifices a part of itself to light up your way.
tconstruct.modifier.harvestwidth.desc: §oExpand!§r\nIncreases the width of the area affected by your tool. The effect is tool specific.
tconstruct.modifier.harvestheight.desc: §oExpand!§r\nIncreases the height of the area affected by your tool. The effect is tool specific.
tconstruct.modifier.haste.desc: §oWeeeeeee!§r\nThe redstone impulse when using your tool motivates your tool to move even faster.
tconstruct.modifier.knockback.desc: §oHomerun!§r\nTeach things how to fly - the cool way.
tconstruct.modifier.luck.desc: §oShiny!§r\nYou're getting all the nice things. And a lot of them.
tconstruct.modifier.mending_moss.desc: §oIt's alive!§r\nPicked up XP is stored in the tool. It will slowly use up the XP to regenerate durability.
tconstruct.modifier.necrotic.desc: §oI feel so Alive!!§r\nHitting enemies returns health to you depending on damage dealt.
tconstruct.modifier.reinforced.desc: §oSo strong!§r\nEach level adds a %s chance to not use durability.
tconstruct.modifier.sharpness.desc: §oOuch!§r\nSo sharp, it hurts to look at it.
tconstruct.modifier.shulking.desc: §oUp up and away!§r\nHitting foes causes them to float away.
tconstruct.modifier.silktouch.desc: §oSmooth as silk!§r\nMined blocks drop themselves instead of the usual items.
tconstruct.modifier.soulbound.desc: §oA merry couple!§r\nYou love your tool. Not even death can part you.
tconstruct.modifier.webbed.desc: §oYuck!§r\nEntangle your foes in cobwebs, slowing them.

chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.chiseled_block.l: Left-click to place the block. Sneak while placing to ignore block grid. Shift + Mouse Wheel to cycle placement rotation.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.bit_bag.long: Automatically re-stocks, and store bits when you exceed or go under a stack in your inventory.\n\nCraft with any dye to color.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.wrench.long: Right-click blocks to rotate them around the axis of the face you click.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.tape_measure.lon: Left-click to and drag to measure spaces. Sneak Use to remove previously created measurements. Use the menu to switch between measurement modes.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.bit.long: Left-click to chisel the highlighted area. Right-click to place at the designated area.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.positiveprint.lo: Right-click on a chiseled block to write the design. Right-click on a block to chisel it adding and removing any bits that do not match the design. You can also place the design in a crafting table and Craft with bits/bags. Shift + Mouse Wheel can be used to cycle rotations without moving.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.negativeprint.lo: Right-click on a chiseled block to write the design. Right-click on a block to chisel it removing any bits that are not in the negative design. Shift + Mouse Wheel can be used to cycle rotations without moving.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.mirrorprint.long: Right-click on a chiseled block face on wish to mirror from, clicking an east facing face will mirror it along the east->west axis. Craft written design with a positive or negative design to transfer the mirror image to the type of design you want.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.chisel.long: Left-click any compatible block to chisel. Right-click to cycle through chisel modes, you can also use Shift + Mouse Wheel to cycle modes.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.bitsaw.long: Craft this saw with supported blocks, or symmetrical chiseled blocks to cut them in half. The axis of cutting is determined by the position of the saw related the block, cut along the X axis with the saw to the side, along the Y axis if the saw is above or below, and Z is if the saw is diagonal.
chiselsandbits.mod.chiselsandbits.help.bittank.long: Right-click with a bucket to insert/remove fluid. Right-click without a bucket to extract bits from a filled tank, shift+right click inserts bits in your hand, inserting with an empty hand will attempt to insert as many bits as possible. You can use automation such as hoppers to extract bits from a tank with fluid in it.

industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.title: Industrial Foregoing's Manual
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_byp: When provided with power it will collect {Sewage} from the animals in top.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_gro: When provided with power and {breeding} food, it will feed baby animals to make them {grow} faster.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_ind: When provided with power it will move {baby} animals from the back to the front.@L@@L@If {Adult Filter} is installed it will move adult animals instead of baby animals.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_res: When provided with power it will try to interact animals with {buckets} and {shears} to milk cows and shear sheeps.@L@@L@It will also get {ink sacks} from squids.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.animal_sto: When provided with power and {food} for the animals it will feed them and put them in the mood. It needs the breeding item for the animal.\@L@\@L@There can only be {35} animals at the same time in the working area.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.biofuel_ge: Produces power when provided with Biofuel. A {bucket} of biofuel will produce 160RF/t, a total {640,000}RF. About {28} generators can be run from 1 {Bioreactor}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.bioreactor: When provided with {power} and {bio materials} will produce {biofuel}.@L@@L@Each item will increase the efficiency of all the items by {10}mb, at maximum efficiency, the reactor will produce {1440}mb consuming {9} different items.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.black_hole: Deprecated use the Black Hole Controller v2.0
It can hold 12 {Black Hole Units} and {Black Hole Tanks} and access their contents.
It can can hold up to {2,147,483,647}mb of one fluid.
It can can hold up to {2,147,483,647} of one item.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.block_dest: When provided with power, it will {break} any block in front of it and move it to its inventory.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.block_plac: When provided with power, it will {place} in front of it the blocks in its inventory.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.crop_enric: When provided with power and fertilizer it will bonemeal crops and saplings.@L@@L@Accepted fertilizers: {bonemeal}, {Industrial Foregoing's} and {Forestry} fertilizer.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.crop_recol: When provided with power it will {harvest} fully grown crops and chop down trees, this includes pumpkins, melons and nether wart. Each operation will produce a bit of {sludge} that can be used in the {Sludge Refiner} to obtain some material. (Having the tank full will {not} slow the machine)
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.crop_sower: Plants seeds and saplings to be gathered in the {Plant Gatherer}. You can {lock} the slots by clicking in the lock and it will {filter} the inputs.@L@@L@The {colored} background represents the colored parts in the {top} of the block.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.dye_mixer: It will produce {dye} more efficiently that normal crafting.@L@@L@Giving it {red} dye, {green} dye and {blue} dye will fill the color buffers. When given a {Laser Lens} will focus that color and produce the specified dye.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.enchantmen: When provided with power it will act like an {anvil} but instead of player experience levels it will use {Essence} to achieve it.
When provided with power, a {book} and a {enchanted} item it will remove {1} enchantment from the item and apply it to the book.@L@@L@The enchanted item won't be damaged in the process.
When provided with power, an {enchanteable} item and {Essence} it will enchant the item just like an {enchanting table} does.@L@@L@It will use {3} buckets of Essence to do a {30} level enchant.
When provided with power and {any} item it will {sort} enchanted items from non enchanted items.@L@@L@Enchanted items will go to the {top} row and the non enchanted ones will go to the {bottom} row.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.energy_fie: The {Energy Field Addon} is an item that will go into the addon slots of any working machine. It will give {power} to the machines from its internal buffer.@L@@L@The {Energy Field Provider} will charge the internal buffer of the addons that are {linked} to it and are in its {range}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.fluid_craf: The {fluid crafter} will craft anything that needs {one} fluid type instead of using the {buckets} in the recipe. To make it work you need to put the items in the grid and {lock it}. After that you can supply the items in the grid and the fluid in the tank.@L@@L@If the recipe has multiple of one item you can use {Item Splitter} to use it easier.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.fluid_pump: When placed above a fluid, the Fluid Pump will take that fluid as a {filter} and begin to drain all fluids of the same type in the working area, it will search all the fluids {below} the fluids in the working area and drain them too. @L@@L@All the drained fluids will be replaced with {cobblestone}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.hydrator: When provided with power it will increase the {grow speed} of the crops in the working area.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.item_split: It will {split} the defined stack size on each slot of the allowed sides of the {output}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.laser_base: When fully charged with {Laser Drills} it will produce ores based on depth and biome.@L@@L@You can increase the chance of producing an ore by adding {Laser Lens} to it.@L@@L@You can decrease the chance of an ore by using an {Laser Lens (Inverted)}, that will increase the chance of the other ores a bit.@L@@L@{Check JEI for chances}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.laser_dril: When placed {1} block away of a {Laser Base} it will charge it with power.@L@@L@If it is wrongly placed it will have a name tag on top telling you so.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.latex_proc: When provided with {power}, {water} and {latex} will produce tiny dry rubber.@L@@L@It will consume {75}mb of latex and {1000}mb of water to produce {1} tiny dry rubber.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.lava_fabri: When provided with large amounts of power, it will produce {lava}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.material_s: When provided with power it will start generating {cobblestone}. It has {4} operations that the machine can do. It can {smelt} items, {2x2} craft them, it can {grind} them and it can {3x3} craft them.@L@@L@For example, the first slot has cobble and the first operation is 'Smelt', then the cobble will turn into stone, the second operation is 2x2 craft, then the stone will turn into stone bricks, etc.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_detect: It will emit a {Redstone Signal} to the back depending on the amount of entities in front of it.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_duplic: When provided with power, {Essence} and any entity in a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} it will spawn them around it.@L@@L@It will {count} the entities nearby and stop spawning if there are too many.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_reloca: When provided with power it will {kill} any entity in front of it as if a player would.@L@@L@It will {collect} the dropped items and it will transform the experience orbs into {Essence}". When having the {Adult Filter Addon} it will kill only adult mobs.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_slaugh: When provided with power it will {grind} any entity in front of it and produce {Liquid Meat} from it.@L@@L@It will {not} drop items or experience in the process.@L@@L@It will also produce some {pink} slime in the process.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.orediction: It will transform items with the same {oredicted} entry into the filtered item.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.ore_proces: It will break down {Silk Touched} ores into its drops.@L@@L@Providing it with {Essence} break them with fortune.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.petrified_: When provided with any {solid fuel} will produce power. The {RF}/tick is decided from its burn time, the more {burn time} the fuel has the more {RF}/tick it will produce.@L@@L@NOTE: All fuels burn the same time.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.potion_ene: When provided with power it will act like an advanced version of the {brewing stand}.@L@@L@First of all it will {fill} glass bottles with water then it will start {brewing} all the ingredients in the top row in {order}, from left to right.@L@@L@Follow the {arrow} to check the current operation.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.protein_ge: "Produces power when provided with Protein. A {bucket} of protein will produce 320RF/t, a total {1,280,000}RF.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.protein_re: When provided with {power} and {some animals drops} will produce {protein}.@L@@L@Each item will increase the efficiency of all the items by {10}mb, at maximum efficiency, the reactor will produce {1440}mb consuming {9} different items.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.resourcefu: It acts like a normal {furnace} but it can burn {3} items at a time and will produce a bit of {Essence} each time a item is smelted.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.sewage_com: When provided with power and {2} buckets of Sewage, it will solidify it into {Fertilizer}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.sludge_ref: When provided with power and {1} bucket of Sludge (Produced in the Plant Gatherer), it will produce {earth like} materials.@L@@L@{If JEI is installed look the uses of the Sludge Refiner to check the chance of the produced materials}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.spores_rec: When provided with power, {1} bucket of water and a {mushroom} of any kind it will grow them internally.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.tree_fluid: When placed in front of any {log} it will produce {Liquid Latex}.@L@@L@It will slowly {consume} the log, each Tree Fluid Extractor contributes to the consuming of the log.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.villager_t: When provided with power and a {Mob Imprisonent Tool} with a {Villager} in it, will give you access to automatically trade with the villager.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.water_cond: When having {2} of more sides with water sources blocks it will start collecting water.@L@@L@The more sides with source blocks the more water it will produce.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.water_reso: When placed over a pool of {3x3} pool of water it will automatically {fish}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.wither_bui: When provided with power, {3} Wither Skulls and {4} soulsand, it will completely build the wither spawning structure in the working area.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.welcome_ma: Welcome to Industrial Foregoing's Manual!@L@@L@To get started you need to place a Tree Fluid Extractor in front of a log to collect Latex and pump into Latex Processing Unit with some water to get Tiny Rubber. @L@@L@{NOTE: Machines don't auto eject, neither they pull! Machines accept RF, FE, Tesla and Mek power.}
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.mob_impris: When right clicked an entity with the item in the hand it will {hold} the entity inside it.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.meat_feede: When the Meat Feeder is in your {inventory} and has some {Liquid Meat} in it, will automatically {feed} you.@L@@L@It acts like a normal fluid container.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.range_addo: It will increase the working {range} of some machines. Not all of the machines will accept them.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.straw: It allows you to {drink} in world fluids or in tanks. It can cause different {effects} depending on the fluid.@L@@L@@L@@L@@L@(I'm not responsible of the bad effects that the straw can cause)
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.pink_slime: Can be obtained by killing a {Pink Slime} that will spawned when placing some {Pink Slime Fluid} in the world.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.upgrades: Industrial Foregoing doesn't have speed upgrades but you can used {Energy Upgrades} and {Speed Upgrades} from Tesla Core Lib to speed up machines. They need the previous tier to be installed to be able to add the next one.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.plant_inte: When provided with power, it will {right click} crops and fruits to harvest them and store them in its inventory or drop them in the ground if they can't be stored. @L@@L@{*It works with Pam's Fruits and Plants by default.}
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.transfer_a: Transfer addons come in all the shapes and forms but only can transfer {items} and {fluids}, and they can pull and they can push.@L@@L@To change the direction of the action simply {right click} it to cycle between the directions or {shift right click} a side of a block to select that direction. You can enchant the addon with {Efficiency} to increase its transfer amount.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.fluiddicti: This machine will transform similar fluids from different mods. You can check {JEI} for possible recipes. You simply need to click on the buttons to select the fluid.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.conveyors: Conveyors will {push} any entites to the direction they are facing. They come on different colors and verticality.@L@@L@They can be upgraded by right-clicking them with {glowstone dust} and the will move entities faster. Right-clicking them with {plastic} will prevent the items from being picked up.@PAGE@It also has a different {upgrades} that can be attached to the sides or the center of the conveyor. They will be placed on the {further} side of the conveyor. Upgrades can be removed by sneak + right clicking on it.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.conveyor_u: The extraction upgrade will try to {extract} items from the inventories that are touching the upgrade and place them inside of the conveyor. @L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and it can be upgraded with {glowstone dust} to speed up the extaction. (It will stop extracting if it extracted too many items that aren't picked up)

The insertion upgrade will try to {insert} items that are touching the upgrade into the inventory touching the upgrade side. @L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist for the insertion. The {range} can be increased in the GUI so it will pick up all the items in the conveyor instead of the items just touching the upgrade.

The detection upgrade is placed in the center part of the conveyor and will emmit a {redstone} signal when triggered by an entity.@L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and you can filter mobs by using a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} with an entity in it. The {redstone control} can be inverted in the GUI.

The bouncing upgrade is placed in the center part of the conveyor and it will {launch} entites in the air in the direction the conveyor is facing.@L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and you can filter mobs by using a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} with an entity in it. The {velocity} values (horizontal and vertical) can be changed in the GUI.

The dropping upgrade is placed in the center part of the conveyor and it will {drop} entities directly below it or insert items in inventories below it.@L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and you can filter mobs by using a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} with an entity in it.

The blinking upgrade is placed in the center part of the conveyor and it will {teleport} entities in a short range in front of the conveyor. @L@@L@It has a {filter} with whitelist or blacklist and you can filter mobs by using a {Mob Imprisonment Tool} with an entity in it. The teleport {distance} can be configured in the GUI.

The splitting upgrade will {distribute} entities evenly, or with the configured ratio, to the side the upgrade is placed.@L@@L@The more {ratio} it has the more entities will go that way. The ratio can be configured in the GUI.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.froster: The froster allows you to create cold substances by spinning the supplied {water} at very fast speeds and reducing the temperature using {power}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.ore_washer: When provided with {liquid meat} and an {ore} it will wash the ore bits with meat into {raw ore meat} for further processing.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.ore_fermen: When provided with {raw ore meat} it will be processed into {fermented ore meat} and growing it's size. It needs a {hot source}(hot fluids, fire, magma blocks) on the bottom and a {cold fluid}(cold fluids, ice, ...) in any other side.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.ore_sieve: When provided with {fermented ore meat} and a little bit of {sand}, it will filter the ore from the meat and transform it into {dust}.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.fortune_ad: It will add {fortune/looting} to the machines that accept the addon. It needs to be enchanted with {Fortune} and it will use the enchantment level for the machine actions.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.pitiful_fu: Works the same as the Petrified Fuel Generator but it only accepts {wood} stuf.
industrialforegoing.text.industrialforegoing.book.infinity_d: A powerful drill that has lost all of it's power. By recharging it will allow you to destroy worlds at a bigger rates. The more power it has, the bigger areas it can mine. In order to preserve that energy it can use {Biofuel} at a more efficient rate. Shift+Right Clicking it will allow you to change the mining area. @L@@L@{It holds secrets that can be easily achieved by Patreons and some rare mobs in the world.}

projecte.pe.manual.pe_alchemical_bag: A practicing alchemist like yourself has no time to constantly pick up and place down Alchemical Chests for storage. By sprinkling High power Covalence Dust on an alchemical chest and wrapping it in cloth, one can shrink the chest down to the size of a pouch. The bag has all the capacity of the chest. Curiously, the bags seem to be bound to some metaphysical network, as all bags of the same color seem to contain the same items, regardless of if the bag was yours or your neighbor's. The bag also seems to activate magical items the same way the chest does.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_philosophers_stone: For centuries legends have been spread about the Philosopher's Stone and its powers. Transmutation without circles, immortality, all of the riches one could desire, and more are said to be within the wielders power. While it may forever be lost to time, modern alchemists have discovered the secret to synthesizing a suitable replacement for some of the more basic powers. Be warned however as those who have succeeded in its creation often have a new look in their eyes, bringing with them tales of fire and demons.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_repair_talisman: Covalence Dust may be a cure-all for tool wear and tear, however manually rubbing it over knicks and dings can get tedious fast. Enter the Repair Talisman, by wrapping up the three colors of Covalence Dust in a tight bundle it can be distributed gradually over the tools in your bag, allowing you to tend to your sheep and perform other tasks of utmost importance.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_fuel_block_2: Like other solid fuels Aeternalis can be compressed into block form. Stylish and efficient.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_alchemy_chest: It is no secret that alchemists like shiny things, a desire for endless gold comes with the territory, but normal storage solutions do not live up to these demands. Enter the Alchemical Chest which can store 104 item stacks, at the cost of one shiny and some Covalence Dust you can store practically endless shinies.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_fuel_block_0: Like other solid fuels Mobius Fuel can be compressed into block form. Use it as a efficient fuel, or a poor mans Red Matter for decor.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_relay_MK1: Relays are your one stop shop for providing EMC to a Condensers and other alchemical devices, simply attach it to the side of one and away you go. EMC can be provided by raw materials, or by an attached Collector. ToDo merge pages.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_dm_block: Raw Dark and Red Matter can be formed into a block, not only can it be used as high class decor in this form, but also as a key material for a number of alchemical devices. ToDo merge pages.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_dm_furnace: Matter furnaces are powerful alchemical devices which can be powered by a EMC source such as a Relay or Collector. They are well known for efficiency due to both their speed, and their ability to automatically output to a nearby chest. ToDo merge pages.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_collector_MK1: Collectors are some of the most controversial alchemical devices due to their ability to generate EMC using nothing more than a light source. This EMC can be transfered to an attached device such as a Relay or Condenser, or used by the collector itself to charge a alchemical item such as a Klein Star. One can also use a collector to transform raw fuel materials into more powerful ones. ToDo merge pages.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_condenser: Transmutation Tables are great for turning one thing into another, however the process is manual and not fit for automation. Condensers are the solution to this problem, simply set a item as the target and anything dumped into it will be transmuted into the target. The target can also be created from EMC provided by a attached device such as a Relay or Collector.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_condenser_mk2: The Energy Condenser MK2 has all the features of the MK1, but splits the inventory to have a separate input and output.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_interdiction_torch: The Interdiction Torch is more than just a stylish alternative to coal and twigs, any mob that approaches it will be pushed away, as a wise man once said... NONE SHALL PASS!
projecte.pe.manual.pe_nova_cataclysm: All the fun of the Nova Catalyst, but with double the boom!
projecte.pe.manual.pe_nova_catalyst: The Nova Catalyst is a powerful alchemical explosive, it causes quite the boom with the added benefit of preserving the nearby blocks for pickup.
projecte.pe.manual.pe_transmutation_stone: The Transmutation Table allows the alchemist to study the makeup of materials, and break down others to create more of them. Dirt goes in, Diamonds come out!
projecte.pe.manual.introduction: By opening this book you have taken the first steps on your journey to become a High Alchemist. Perhaps you are weary of performing the same grindy tasks over and over, or you simply desire more power for... purposes, or you'd like the utility and art of magic at your disposal. Regardless, alchemy is sure to fit your needs. Before you can begin however it is important to understand the past...    The art of alchemy has been known since ancient times. It was discovered by a man known as x3n0ph0b3, and refined through multiple iterations. After x3n0ph0b3's retirement, a new apprentice, Pahimar, took up development of the art, but many alchemists were displeased by his new methods, a war broke out between the two sides with strange audible chants akin to "lazy cheaters" and "EE2 OP!!!!!!" filling the air. x3n0's followers thought all was lost until a wander by the name of MozeIntel led them underground, he had studied and reproduced x3n0's work, thus the old art lived on. Eventually, for reasons unknown (reasons he strangely described as "IRL"), Moze retired, leaving his work to an eager apprentice, SinkillerJ. Sin went on to not only bring peace to the two sides allowing them to coexist, but to also form a council of alchemists dedicated to the preservation of the old art:    Williewillus - Lord of Refactors    Blubberbub - Alchemical Value Archivist    Lilylicious - Lady of Little Big Things    We, the council of alchemists, now impart upon you our most extensive knowledge of the alchemical arts, and welcome you, young alchemist, to the world of ProjectE.

totemic.totemic.gui.lexicon.header: The Totempedia, a guide to all your Totemic needs.
totemic.totemic.page.melody0:
§4Melody§0 is a magical power released from §4Instruments§0 that have been played. Each §1Instrument§0 has a §4Melody Threshold§0, meaning that only a certain amount §4Melody§0 can be released from one §4Instrument§0 for a specific effect.
Maybe in the future this §4Melody§0 will have functions with other things in the world.
totemic.totemic.page.cedarTree0: The §1Red Cedar Tree§0 is a tree that naturally has capabilities for Totemic purposes. It can be obtained by infusing mundane saplings with musical energy in the §4Rite of Spring Ceremony§0. §1Red Cedar Wood§0 has the same properties and crafting applications as standard wood. In addition, a §4Bark Stripper§0 is able to remove its bark to make more efficient uses of its resources.
totemic.totemic.page.cedarTree1: Finally, it can be used to craft certain instruments like the §1Wind Chimes§0 or §1Jingle Dress§0.
totemic.totemic.page.buffaloBasic0: The mighty Buffalo, an animal which is known across the lands for all of the resources it can grant. They are incredibly sturdy and have a very large amount of health. Hunting has left them nearly extinct, but they can still be 'created' with the §4Buffalo Dance Ceremony§0.
totemic.totemic.page.creatingTotems0: Creating a §4Totem Pole§0 is a very simple thing to do. First you must create a §1Totem Whittling Knife§0, which is the tool used to carve out a §4Totem Pole§0 out of any kind of wood logs. The knife can carve different patterns of §4Totem Poles§0, which will lead to different effects. Right clicking or scrolling while sneaking will change which pattern will be carved.
totemic.totemic.page.creatingTotems1:
A Totem Whittling Knife is also needed to carve out the §1Totem Base§0. Each Totem Pole needs one Totem Base at the bottom of the pole, and can can extend 6 meters high.
Totem Poles will by default give beneficial §4effects§0 to all nearby players. The effects depend on the carving pattern. A Totem Pole can have different carvings on different heights.
totemic.totemic.page.totemEffects0:
These are the different effects you can carve on a Totem pole:
§1Bat§0: Negates fall damage and lets you jump further when you sneak mid-air
§1Blaze§0: Gives you Fire Resistance
§1Buffalo§0: Makes you mine faster
totemic.totemic.page.totemEffects1:
§1Cow§0: Gives you resistance to damage, but also slows you down
§1Enderman§0: Gives you night vision
§1Horse§0: Gives you a speed boost
§1Ocelot§0: Prevents Creepers from exploding
§1Pig§0: Brings you good luck
totemic.totemic.page.totemEffects2:
§1Rabbit§0: Gives you a jump boost
§1Spider§0: Lets you climb walls like a spider
§1Squid§0: Gives you Water Breathing
§1Wolf§0: Gives you strength
totemic.totemic.page.medicineBag0:
The §1Medicine Bag§0 allows you to carry a §4Totem Effect§0 with you, so you can use its benefits for a limited time without having to be near a Totem Pole.
Once you have crafted your Medicine Bag, Sneak+Right click it on a Totem Pole block carved with the effect you want to have. Then you can right click the bag to open it and release its effect, or to close it.
totemic.totemic.page.medicineBag1: The Medicine Bag will last for a few minutes before it depletes. To charge it, just stand near a §1Totem Pole§0 that has your bag's effect carved into it.
totemic.totemic.page.instruments0: Instruments are a way to create §4Melody§0, the life of §1Totem Poles§0. When an instrument is played, their melody will seep into a nearby §1Totem Poles§0. Every instrument produces §4Melody§0 in different ways. Along that, each instrument has a different amount of §4Melody§0 that a §4Ceremonies§0 may be able to accept, meaning that many different §4Instruments§0 are needed for effective use.
totemic.totemic.page.windChime0: The §1Wind Chime§0 is an instrument that will wave in the wind and periodically produce §4Melody§0. The §1Wind Chime§0 cannot have any blocks below it, and must be hanging from a block above it. While the §1Wind Chime§0 does not create a large amount of §4Melody§0, it does not require any intervention by players. It is recommended that only a couple of Wind Chimes hang near a §1Totem Pole§0 at once.
totemic.totemic.page.windChime1: It is not rare to see §1Wind Chimes§0 hanging from the branches of leaves, there have even been rumors that it could make them create more §4Melody§0. When the §1Wind Chime§0 is playing, it will shake vigorously and create §1Melody§0. Because the music from the §1Wind Chime§0 is so easy to come by, the §4Melody Threshold§0 is easily reached. Hitting a §1Wind Chime§0 whilst §4Sneaking§0 will make it play in §4Selector Mode§0.
totemic.totemic.page.drum0: The §1Drum§0 is an instrumental block that can be played by simply bashing it with either fist. All §1Totemists§0 should learn the rhythm which is used when a §1Flute§0 and a §1Drum§0 are being played together, as it may be required for early §1Ceremonies§0.
totemic.totemic.page.drum1: It is recommended to have a few §1Drums§0 around a §1Totem Pole§0 in order to be able alternatively play them. As with most instruments, §4sneaking§0 when playing it will allow you to select a §4Ceremony§0.
totemic.totemic.page.jingleDress0: The §1Jingle Dress§0. One of the most prestigious pieces of clothing available for any §4Totemists§0. It is a leaf dress adorned with bells. Running will create §4Melody§0, they say the faster you run the more it creates, and a speed potion increases it even further! Perhaps its effect could be activated by running in between §1Drum§0 beats.
totemic.totemic.page.jingleDress1: Because the effect of this §1Instrument§0 is fairly passive, it does not create much §4Melody§0, and its §4Melody Threshold§0 is easily reached. Interestingly enough, it seems like the §4Jingle Dress§0 is one of the few §4Instruments§0 that cannot be used as a §4Ceremony Selector§0.
totemic.totemic.page.flute0: Sometimes a §1Flute§0 can be one of the most simple and effective instruments available. Unlike other instruments, the §1Flute§0 simply plays music without any complication. Because of its simplicity, it is not known to be the most melodic instrument, meaning it will not create much §4Melody§0, and its §4Melody Threshold§0 will be reached easily. When §4sneaking§0, it can be used to select a §4Ceremony§0 for any nearby §4Totem Poles§0.
totemic.totemic.page.flute1: The §1Flute§0 can be infused in the §4Serenade for Syrinx§0, giving it special properties.
totemic.totemic.page.rattle0:
The §1Ceremonial Rattle§0 is an §4Instrument§0 which is a backbone of any more advanced §4Ceremonies§0. The §1Rattle§0 produces §4Melody§0 whenever it has been shook with the hand.
It can be used in dual wield: if you hold the Rattle in your right hand, you can have another instrument in your left hand and play both at the same time.
totemic.totemic.page.rattle1: Like all §4Instruments§0, it can be played while §4sneaking§0 so as to activate §4Ceremonies§0.
totemic.totemic.page.eagleBoneWhistle0: The §1Eagle-Bone Whistle§0 is made from the bones of a §4Bald Eagle§0, and as such it is very powerful. It is a necessity for more advanced §4Ceremonies§0, and is actually considered more of a ceremonial object than an §4Instrument§0.
totemic.totemic.page.netherPipe0: The §1Netherumbrian Pipes§0 are one of the most curious instruments of them all. Although a truly vile creation, it has many uses for a Totemist. Charging it up like you would a bow makes its bellows draw in air, and after releasing all of its fumes, the §1Netherumbrian Pipes§0 will drain the life of all nearby crops. After draining their life, it will release a large amount of §4Melody§0. What's interesting about these set of is that they will give
totemic.totemic.page.netherPipe1: off their maximum amount of music within a few plays. Do not take that lightly however, as each play creates several times more music than any other instrument. After crafting, an activation is required. To do this, simply take damage from wither effects with the §1Netherumbrian Pipes§0 in hand. Interestingly enough, it seems to prefer the life essence of Nether Wart.
totemic.totemic.page.basicsCeremonies0: §4Ceremonies§0 are a way for a Totemist to gather strength over a period of time through the power of §4Melody§0 to release a central burst of energy on both players and the nearby world. The center of a Ceremony is a §1Totem Base§0 and it also is where the effects of a Ceremony are released from. Ceremonies are powered by the §4Melody§0 that is released from §4Instruments§0 when they are played.
totemic.totemic.page.basicsCeremonies1: There are two main points in a Ceremony, the first being §4Selection§0, and the second being the §4Ceremony Effects§0.
totemic.totemic.page.selectingCeremonies0: In order to select which §4Ceremony§0 you wish to activate, a specific task must be complete. Any §4Instruments§0 played whilst §4Sneaking§0 will play in their §4Selector Mode§0, and will not release any §4Melody§0 as they would normally. A combination of two §4Instruments§0 in §4Selector Mode§0 will start a Ceremony depending on which were played. For example, using the §1Flute§0 in selector mode twice will activate the §4Serenade of the Depths§0.
totemic.totemic.page.performingCeremonies0: Once a §4Ceremony§0 has been selected, the §4startup§0 will initiate. While it is in this stage, the §1Totem Pole§0 will accept any played §1Melody§0 and store it. In order for a Ceremony effect to activate, a certain amount of §4Melody§0 is required depending on how difficult the Ceremony is. This difficulty is represented by how many ♪ there are in its entry in this book. When the §4Melody Requirement§0 for the Ceremony is reached, it will activate.
totemic.totemic.page.performingCeremonies1: Each §4Instrument§0 can only be played up to a certain point, meaning a Ceremony could not be played with just one §4Instrument§0. This is known as the §4Melody Threshold§0. Any smoke that emits from the §1Totem Base§0 will signify that the most recently played §4Instrument§0 has reached its §4Melody Threshold§0 for that Ceremony, and the user should stop using that specific §4Instrument§0 for the rest of the Ceremony.
totemic.totemic.page.performingCeremonies2: Additionally, there is a limited amount of time to complete a Ceremony, meaning playing speed is important. After you have created enough §4Melody§0, the Ceremony will begin performing its effects. Some Ceremonies have instant effects, others will last over a certain amount of time after the effect initially starts. It should be noted that the effects can only pertain for a certain amount of time, and will stop after that time has elapsed.
totemic.totemic.page.performingCeremonies3: Finally, there should be care taken with the timing between playing §4Instruments§0, in order to complete a Ceremony efficiently, a rhythm between instruments may be important. Because of that, it is recommended that a §4Totemist§0 spends some time getting used to the rhythms of certain §4Instruments§0.
totemic.totemic.page.ceremonyTips0:
• After you selected a Ceremony, you need to §4stop sneaking§0 so that your music counts for the Ceremony.
• If you see white smoke coming from the Totem Pole after playing an instrument, its §4Melody Threshold§0 is reached and you should stop playing it.
• §4Wind Chimes§0 play at somewhat regular intervals. Try to time your Ceremony around them.
totemic.totemic.page.ceremonyTips1:
• More Instruments of the same kind usually don't help that much. Try getting more §4unique Instruments§0 if you can.
• That said, it can be helpful to have two §4Drums§0 and two or three §4Wind Chimes§0.
• Try holding your Flute in the §4left hand§0 and your Rattle in the §4right hand§0 to play both at once.
totemic.totemic.page.ceremonyTips2:
• If you want to cancel a Ceremony, e.g. when you made a wrong selection, you can §4left-click§0 your Totemic Staff on the Totem Base.
• The time you have available to complete a Ceremony changes with §4game difficulty§0.
totemic.totemic.page.warDance0: The §4War Dance Ceremony§0 is a Ceremony that will heighten your senses for an incoming war and bring the adrenalin to your entire body. After performing it, the §4Ceremony§0 will bring the user Speed and Strength for a long period of time time, allowing them to rush to battle.
totemic.totemic.page.depths0: The §4Symphony of the Depths§0, along with the §4War Dance§0 are some of the most basic and mundane §4Ceremonies§0 of all. The effect of this §4Ceremony§0 is as simple as it is to perform, any nearby players will be blessed with a §4Water Breathing§0 effect for a few minutes.
totemic.totemic.page.fertility0:
The §4Rite of Spring§0 is the one of the many growth and fertility §4Ceremonies§0 available to a Totemist. After activating, all nearby animals and villagers will sequentially proceed to breed, consuming food items or Emeralds respectively. However there is a decent chance that a food item will not be consumed.
Along with that, any nearby saplings will transform into §1Red Cedar Saplings§0.
totemic.totemic.page.zaphkielWaltz0: The §4Zaphkiel Waltz§0 is a growth and fertility §4Ceremony§0 that affects nearby crops. For a short while, nearby plants will grow at a much faster rate than usual. In addition, any nearby §1Eggs§0 will have a chance to hatch into living §4Chickens§0 at a much higher rate than they would if they were thrown.
totemic.totemic.page.buffaloDance0: This beast used to roam the lands in large herds, but was mysteriously wiped out long before you came into this world. However, not all hope is lost. The §4Buffalo Dance§0 Ceremony is able to give strength to nearby Cows and turn them into Buffalos. They will start out as infants and only gain their full strength after a while.
totemic.totemic.page.rainDance0: The §4Rain Dance Ceremony§0 is a way for you to bring a torrent of rain into the world. If the rain becomes too much to bare, the §4Drought Ceremony§0 is always available, which will remove all rain. Because the effects of this §4Ceremony§0 are so potent, it may be hard to perform.
totemic.totemic.page.drought0: The §4Drought Ceremony§0 will clear the sky and end any storms that may be plaguing your world. It is simply the opposite of the §4Rain Dance Ceremony§0.
totemic.totemic.page.fluteInfusion0: The §4Serenade for Syrinx§0 is a way to enchant a regular §1Flute§0 with melodic energy, giving it special properties. Nearby flutes in your inventory or on the ground will be infused with Totemic energy, becoming §1Pan's Flute§0. The timbre of her Flute is quite more beautiful than that of a mundane one, meaning it produces more §4Melody§0 and works better with §4Totem Poles§0.
totemic.totemic.page.fluteInfusion1: In addition, nearby §1Animals§0 and §1Villagers§0 will be completely and utterly unable to resist the melody, and will follow you if you play the flute.
totemic.totemic.page.eagleDance0:
The §1Bald Eagle§0 is a sacred bird, some say they are spiritual messengers between humans and gods. Its feathers and bones are important ceremonial items and are used to make the §1Eagle-Bone Whistle§0.
Since they have gone almost extinct, they are not found in the wild; similarly to Buffalos they have to be created by the §4Eagle Dance§0 Ceremony. This Ceremony will infuse
totemic.totemic.page.eagleDance1: nearby §1Parrots§0 and turn them into Bald Eagles. Once transformed, they can be tamed with any kind of raw fish and bred with Salmon.
totemic.totemic.page.cleansing0: §4Steve's Lullaby§0 is such a beautiful and cleansing piece that it is able to calm down, and remove the evil properties of a few select monsters in the world. §4Zombie Villagers§0 will become their living counterpart. The same will occur for §4Zombie Pigmen§0, becoming regular §4Pigs§0. Only a few monsters will be affected per activation, and they need to have been §4weakened§0 by a potion effect first.
totemic.totemic.page.baykokSummon0:
§4Totentanz§0 is a Ceremony that will summon the spirit known as §1Baykok§0. Do not attempt this ceremony unless you are well equipped for combat.
§1Baykok§0 is an evil spirit who appears as a skeleton-like figure. He ruthlessly hunts warriors and is a master of archery, attacking with invisible arrows.
totemic.totemic.page.baykokSummon1: If you manage to defeat §1Baykok§0, you will be able to get his bow, among other loots. Any §1Arrows§0 fired from §1Baykok's Bow§0 are visible only to the bow wielder. In addition, his bow is stronger and has a higher §4Enchantability§0 than a mundane bow.
totemic.totemic.page.sunDance0:
The §4Sun Dance§0 is one of the most sacred Ceremonies, and also the most painful one to perform: You will be faced with a §1near-death experience§0. If you pull through, you and everyone nearby will be healed and protected from damage for a while.
The Sun Dance will not reduce your health below half a heart.
totemic.totemic.page.danseMacabre0: The §4Danse Macabre§0 is probably the most deceptive §4Ceremony§0 of them all. All nearby §1Rotten Flesh§0 on the ground will transform into very, very dangerous §4Zombies§0. Whilst this may seem like a downside, there is a decent chance that the creation will instead be a §4Zombie Villagers§0. Interestingly enough, if performed in the §1Nether§0 it seems like a different monster will spawn in the world instead.
totemic.totemic.page.danseMacabre1: These effects effectively mean that §1Rotten Flesh§0 can be converted into §4Experience Points§0, or if it is combined with §4Steve's Lullaby§0, it will be able to create §4Villagers§0.
totemic.totemic.page.totemicStaff0:
The §1Totemic Staff§0 can be used to gather information on several blocks by right clicking on them.
In addition, holding one whilst left-clicking a Totem Base will cancel ceremonies, and any musical selections on it.
totemic.totemic.page.barkStripper0: The §1Bark Stripper§0 is a way for you to remove the bark from your §1Red Cedar Logs§0 and reveal stripped wood from the tree. To do so, just hold the §1Bark Stripper§0 in your hand, and right click on the log, after a few seconds it will finish stripping the bark from the log, revealing the stripped log.
totemic.totemic.page.barkStripper1:
The §1Red Cedar Stripped Log§0 can be crafted into planks at a more efficient rate, and can be put in a furnace to create charcoal.
Red Cedar Stripped Logs that are left on grass will slowly regrow their bark after a while.
totemic.totemic.page.baykokBow0:
§1Baykok's Bow§0 is a powerful bow that can only be obtained by slaying the spirit §1Baykok§0. §1Baykok§0 can be summoned with the §4Totentanz§0 Ceremony.
Arrows fired from this bow deal more damage, and non-tipped arrows will become invisible to anyone but you. The bow also has a higher §4Enchantability§0, and is more durable than a mundane bow.
totemic.totemic.page.tipi0: The §1Tipi§0 is cone shaped tent which can be used to sleep through the night. It consists of a wooden frame, adorned with a tarp consisting of either Buffalo hide or textile. It can be placed on top of a flat surface of grass or dirt, and requires an open sky to be used.
totemic.totemic.page.totemTorch0: The §1Totem Torch§0 is simply a larger and more decorative version of a regular torch.
totemic.totemic.page.woodenPillars0: §1Wooden Pillars§0 are simple decorative blocks that, unlike Totem Poles, have no carvings and can be oriented in any direction. They, as well as §1Pillar Bases§0, can be made from any type of wood.

projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.welcome.title: Welcome to Project Intelligence!
projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.welcome.text: This is an open source project created by brandon3055. The goal of this project is to create a truly universal documentation mod by leveraging the power of the minecraft community.  So how will this work? well for starters any mod developer can add documentation for their mods to PI. The problem is mod devs are busy people so most of them wont have time to deal with something like this and that in my opinion is a major issue with most of the current documentation mods.  PI aims to solve this problem by making it possible for anyone in the community to contribute by writing documentation for various mods using the relatively simple built in editor. They can then submit their documentation via PR and if it passes review it will be added to the online repository.
projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.guide_intro.title: What is this?
projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.guide_intro.text: This is the first launch introduction. It will walk you through some of the main features in project intelligence. If this is not your first time here then feel free to skip this intro.  Most features in PI are pretty self explanatory but there are a few less obvious features you may find useful.
projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.basic_overview.text: Everything here should be pretty self explanatory. Hover your mouse over any of the arrows to view info about that item.
projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.pi_interaction.title: General PI Interaction
projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.pi_interaction.text: This is just a general overview of some of the different ways you can use PI. As you have probably already figured out you can open PI by pressing %s.  PI Also has an "Explain This" function which allows you to press %s while hovering your mouse over an item in an inventory to view any documentation related to that item. You can also press %s to view available documentation for a block or entity you are looking at in world.  PI GUI Notes: Whenever you open the main PI UI you will return to the previous page you had open. When you open PI for the first time in a session you will get the "Home Page" by default this is the Project Intelligence mod page but you can change this by right clicking on a page in the page list and selecting the "set as home page" option.
projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.ui_style.text: This gui is extremely customizable! You can find the style settings by pressing the options button in the top right corner of PI. There you will find some builtin style presets and an option to edit the current preset which you can then save as your own custom preset!
projectintelligence.pi.info_screen.contributing.text: If you would like to contribute by writing documentation for a mod then please check out then please check out the "Contribute" page in the PI documentation which you can find in... well.. PI!
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.back_forward.txt: Forward/Back buttons. These work like that back/forward buttons in a web browser allowing you to go back to previously visited pages then forward from there.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.toggle_nav.txt: Allows you to hide/show the navigation window.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.button_list.txt: This is a simple tree based navigation system where the root branch contains a list of mod pages. When you select a page from this list that page's sub pages will be displayed here if it has any. Otherwise the page will simply be highlighted.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.current_directory.tx: This shows a truncated view of the path to the current page. e.g. Home/Draconic Evolution/Draconium Chest. It can be used to navigate to a previous page.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.search_box.txt: This is a search box. Pretty self explanatory. It allows you to search for pages.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.search_settings.txt: The search settings allow you to change the scope of the search.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.settings.txt: Here you can find all of the settings for PI. It should be noted that all settings for PI are in game and there is no user editable config file.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.minimize.txt: Minimize/Maximize allow you to change the size of this UI.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.content_tabs.txt: TABS! Yes PI has tabs. When opening a page simply middle click or right click > Open in new tab.
projectintelligence.pi.intro.arrow_info.content_window.txt: This is the content window. Its where the content is!
projectintelligence.pi.internet_access_info.txt: Please be aware as all project intelligence documentation is stored online the mod requires internet access to function correctly.
projectintelligence.pi.internet_access_more_info.txt: On first launch PI will download and cache all available documentation pages for the installed mods. Any images are downloaded and cached on an as-needed basis to reduce internet usage.
projectintelligence.pi.internet_access_denied.txt: Please be aware PI does not currently support running in "Offline Mode" If you want to use PI in the future you need to allow internet access.

enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.drawbridge: - Extends or contracts a line of blocks|lf- The maximum length of the line is adjustable|lf- The delay between operations is adjustable|lf- To use a specific orientation of blocks or blocks|lf  with TileEntity data preserved, build them|lf  in the world and then click "Take block states from world"|lf- For the Normal Drawbridge, the state is taken|lf  from the first block infront of the Drawbridge|lf- Can be camouflaged by right clicking with an|lf  empty main hand, while holding a block in the offhand|lf- Sneak + right click with an empty hand|lf  to remove the camouflage
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.inserter_fil: - Tries to insert items to the "side outputs" first|lf- If that fails, or they aren't allowed by the filters,|lf   then the items will go out the "normal out" side instead|lf- Input filtering is only for pulling items, other things|lf   could still push non-allowed items into the Inserter|lf- Sneak + right click with an empty hand to change the output sides|lf- The stack limit defines how many items will be moved at once|lf- (Shift and/or Ctrl) left/right/middle click or scroll over|lf   the +/- buttons to change the values
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.inserter_nor: - Tries to insert items to the "side outputs" first|lf- If that fails then the items will go out the "normal out" side instead|lf- Sneak + right click with an empty hand to change the output sides|lf- The stack limit defines how many items will be moved at once|lf- (Shift and/or Ctrl) left/right/middle click or scroll over|lf  the +/- buttons to change the values
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.inventoryswa: - Can swap the player's inventory with the|lf  currently selected memory card's contents|lf- Player inventory slots marked as blue|lf  are enabled for swap operation|lf- Middle click to toggle individual slots|lf- In Cycle mode changing the selected card|lf  effectively does 'swap + change card + swap',|lf  which allows quickly cycling through multiple|lf  sets of items
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.memory_chest: - Middle click to lock the current item type for the slot|lf- You can also middle click (and/or drag)|lf  with items in cursor to do it faster|lf- Only that type of item can enter an empty slot|lf- A Private chest can't be opened by others,|lf  and it is also unbreakable
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.msu: - Middle click (items in cursor or slot): lock the slot to that item|lf- Alt + middle click: Swap two stacks|lf- Shift + Middle click (in Creative): Fill stack (> 1 item in cursor)|lf  or cycle the stack size in x10 increments (1 item in cursor)
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.nullifier: - Just a nullifier, but with 9 large slots...|lf- Will auto-pickup any matching items that it currently has stored|lf- Any partial stacks will be filled first, and then the rest will be voided|lf- Right click with to place the block that is currently selected|lf- Ctrl + Toggle/Scroll: Change slot selection|lf- Ctrl + middle click to empty/void a slot's contents
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.pickupmanage: - Can control what the player is allowed to pick up|lf- Can also directly transport items to a remote inventory|lf- The transport filters are checked first|lf- If they are disabled, or the item is not allowed there|lf  then the Inventory filters are checked next|lf- The transport filters determine which items will get transported on pickup|lf- The Inventory filters determine which items the player can pick up,|lf  assuming the item didn't get transported|lf- Note: Needs a capacitor to transport items! (add in a Tool Workstation)
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.portalpanel: - You can add a dye per destination in the Dye slot|lf- The dye will change the created portal's color (cosmetic only!)|lf- The destination location comes from the Link Crystal when a portal is activated|lf- A Portal Panel must be placed ON a Portal Frame block,|lf  which is connected to a valid portal "frame loop" via|lf  a "continuous path" of Portal Frame blocks|lf  (diagonal connection is not enough)|lf- The portal frame loop itself however can also contain diagonal corners|lf- The maximum sizes for the portal forming algorithm are configurable|lf  (see the config file or the in-game config menu)
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.quickstacker: - By default only moves items that|lf  already exist in the target inventory|lf- Sneak to move all items from enabled slots|lf  (even if they aren't already present in the target inventory)|lf- Use the Toggle hotkey to activate|lf- Can be sneak + right clicked on inventories|lf  to quick stack matching items to that inventory|lf- Player inventory slots marked as blue|lf  are enabled for quick stacking|lf- Middle click to toggle individual slots|lf- Doesn't need to be held to use|lf  (but does then need to be the first found|lf  "unselected keybind operatable item" in the inventory)
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.quick_stacke: - Player inventory slots marked as blue|lf  are enabled for quick stacking|lf- Middle click to toggle individual slots|lf- Double left-click the block to activate|lf- By default only moves items that already|lf  exist in the target inventory|lf- Sneak while activating to move all items|lf  from enabled slots|lf- Left click the module selection buttons to select|lf  that Memory Card/filters for configuration|lf- Right click the button to enable/disable|lf  that target inventory|lf- In Area mode the maximum range is 16 blocks|lf- In bound targets mode the maximum range is 32 blocks
enderutilities.enderutilities.gui.infoarea.sound_block: - Volume values over 1 increase the maximum range|lf- The range will be Volume * 16 blocks

plustic.stat.laser_medium.power.desc: How powerful the laser medium is.

plustic.stat.battery_cell.energy.desc: How much energy the tool can store.
plustic.modifier.bloodymary.desc: §oBrought to you by the legendary Queen of England...§r\nDeals bonus damage depending on the amount of health already lost by the target. Also, a chance to drop a Coagulated Blood for each hit.
plustic.modifier.naturesblessing.desc: §oWonderful...§r\nA chance to drop bread per mob killed or block broken. Sometimes heals the player by a bit after killing a mob.
plustic.modifier.natureswrath.desc: §oNature's wrath burning...§r\nAfter attacking a mob, there is a chance to burn the target, as well as to heal the player.
plustic.modifier.naturespower.desc: §oFeel the power...§r\nAfter attacking a mob: 20% chance to burn target. 20% chance to give player Speed. 20% chance to give player Strength.
plustic.modifier.apocalypse.desc: §oThe end times...§r\nYour victim becomes moribund and is afflicted with increasing levels of Wither.
plustic.modifier.mana.desc: §oRechargeable... with flowers§r\nMana can be used in place of durability, and can heal the tool over time.
plustic.modifier.terrafirma.desc: §oSolid earth§r\nWhile this tool is in your hand (or this armor is worn), you will heal over time.
plustic.modifier.elemental.desc: §oElemental...§r\nWhen gravity-affected blocks are destroyed, break all blocks of the same type above and below. Also, a chance to gain various benefits from a sucessful attack.
plustic.modifier.anticorrosion.desc: §oFor the times when you splash the chemical§r\nEvery tick, there is a small chance that the holder's poison is healed (when held in hand).
plustic.modifier.explosive.desc: §oKa-boom!§r\nAn explosion is created on each hit.
plustic.modifier.global.desc: §oAround the world... and back§r\nShift-right-click a block in order for items from broken blocks and killed entities to get transported in there if it is an inventory.
plustic.modifier.divineshield.desc: §oOf the guardians, by the guardians, and for the guardians§r\nWhile this tool is in your hand, you are granted fire resistance. Also, damage is reduced, but at a durability cost.
plustic.modifier.portly.desc: §oTesting nuclear bombs off the Korean coast, oh yeah!§r\nShift-right-click an entity to capture it (costs durability based on entity health). Press the "release entity" key (default "0") in order to release it.
plustic.modifier.nickoftime.name: Nick of Time
plustic.modifier.nickoftime.desc: §oPhew!§r\nPress the "set portal" key (default "N") to set a virtual portal on the block you are pointing at (shift for armor; do not shift for tools). If you are on the brink of death, you have %d ender pearls to spare, and the portal has enough space above, then the pearls are consumed, you are teleported to the virtual portal, and you are spared. (The tool must be in your hand.)
plustic.modifier.blindbandit.desc: §oPulling a ... someone.§r\nA mob called the "Blind Bandit" will sometimes be summoned for a limited time after you attack or are attacked. She will attack hostile mobs, and will also attack those who dare attack her (except you), piercing armor on mobs.
plustic.modifier.brownmagic.desc: §oYou're weird.§r\nPress the "set portal" key (default "N") to set a virtual portal on the block you are pointing at. By default, press "Y" to teleport there (if there is enough space).
plustic.modifier.rudeawakening.desc: §oThe hydra grovels before me...§r\nDamage pierces armor (mobs only).
plustic.modifier.mirabile.desc: §oWonderful to see§r\nOccasionally, a gold or diamond ore will appear in stone immediately surrounding you (at the cost of durability).
plustic.modifier.botanical.desc: §oI eat zombies for breakfast§r\nIncreases the amount of modifier slots; the effect stacks greatly.
plustic.modifier.unnamed.name: He Who Must Not Be Named
plustic.modifier.unnamed.desc: §oIt's you-know-who...§r\nBonus damage accrued for each entity of the same type as the target close to it.
plustic.modifier.darktraveler.desc: §oAll hail...the King of Chaos!§r\nSurrounding mobs get randomly afflicted with damage.
plustic.modifier.illuminati.desc: §oConfirmed!§r\nWhile the tool is in your hand, nearby entities (that do not hold a tool with this trait) glow, and you become invisible.
plustic.modifier.hailhydra.desc: §oHeads§r\nRandom explosions plague your enemies. Also, when you are attacked, there is a chance to get Absorption.
plustic.modifier.barrett.desc: §oBam!§r\nAs health decreases, there is an increasing chance of a critical hit.
plustic.modifier.morganlefay.name: Morgan Le Fay
plustic.modifier.morganlefay.desc: §oLancelot...§r\nBonus magic damage (ranging from 0.0 to 5.0; Gaussian distributed) is afflicted (it is absolute).
plustic.modifier.trash.desc: §oTraaaaaassshhh!§r\nRandom stuff is slowly generated when the tool is selected, but the tool is damaged slowly in this way.
plustic.modifier.ignoble.desc: §oTo a new low§r\nAs one takes damage, one starts to harbor feelings of ignoble jealousy as the offender is killed. When this trait is enabled, those feelings are vented when attacking while sneaking.
plustic.modifier.dprk.name: Democratic People's Republic of Korea
plustic.modifier.dprk.desc: §oWhen your missiles explode right after launch§r\nWhen attacking or defending, Supreme Leaders will spawn, exploding on opponents in the same manner as a creeper.
plustic.modifier.getlucky.desc: §oLike the legend of the phoenix...§r\nPress the "set portal" key (default "N") to set a virtual portal on the block you are pointing at. If you are on the brink of death, you have %d phoenixite gems to spare, and the portal has enough space above, then the gems are consumed, you are teleported to the virtual portal, and you are spared. (The tool must be in your hand.)
plustic.modifier.vindictive.desc: §oYou are not forgiven!§r\nBonus damage to players, and you gain some health by attacking.
plustic.modifier.starfishy.desc: §o2+2=5§r\nPress the "set portal" key (default "N") to set a virtual portal on the block you are pointing at. If you are on the brink of death, you have %d enori crystals to spare, and the portal has enough space above, then the crystals are consumed, you are teleported to the virtual portal, and you are spared. (The tool must be in your hand.)
plustic.modifier.spades.desc: §oTrump suit: Make Tinkers Great Again!§r\nThe lower your health, the more damage you do.
plustic.modifier.hearts.desc: §oHey, what's with that plus sign on that guy's mod?§r\nThe higher your health, the more damage you do.
plustic.modifier.ghastly.desc: §oOh, the horror!§r\nIf the holder is attacked while sneaking, the attacker is inflicted with Slowness.
plustic.modifier.slashing.desc: §oA critical hit!§r\nCritical hits gain 20% more damage!
plustic.modifier.naphtha.desc: §oChildren of the Sun§r\nArrows (and bolts) burn the target on impact.
plustic.modifier.mystical_fire.desc: §oA hidden secret lies within...§r\nSets the target on fire, and damages the target with magic for a certain amount of time.
plustic.modifier.thaumic.desc: §oYou're back.§r\nA tool with this modifier gains 1 extra modifier slot, or 2 extra slots if either at least 3 parts have this trait, or the tool is made entirely out of parts with this trait.
plustic.modifier.chadthunder.desc: §oThe virgin killing by weapon alone vs the CHAD killing by thunder strikes§r\nEnemies struck by this weapon have thunderbolts rained down on them.
plustic.modifier.fruitsalad.desc: §oYummy yummy§r\nA tool with this trait can store up to 5 types of fruits.
plustic.modifier.stopbeingselfish.name: Stop Being Selfish
plustic.modifier.stopbeingselfish.desc: §oBrayden stop being selfish!§r\nMore damage is added the closer other players are to the attacker.
plustic.modifier.musicofthespheres.name: Music of the Spheres
plustic.modifier.musicofthespheres.desc: §o"The earth is flat!" said Steve§r\nThe tool doubles as a movable boombox.
plustic.modifier.goodfridayagreement_armor.name: Good Friday Agreement
plustic.modifier.goodfridayagreement_armor.desc: §oTroubles over?§r\nIron golems will not attack a player having this trait.
plustic.modifier.camdaibay_armor.name: Cam Dai Bay
plustic.modifier.camdaibay_armor.desc: §oNo, it's not some bay in Vietnam!§r\nIf the player is attacked and is blocking, inflicts the player's negative status effects on the attacker.
plustic.modifier.dunanstransport_armor.desc: §oThe FedEx of one square foot of land§r\nBonus armor protection and toughness for riding players.
plustic.modifier.invariant_armor.desc: §oThe more things change, the more they stay the same.§r\nStops terrain (not entity) damage from nearby explosions.
plustic.modifier.jetpackpancakehippos.name: Jetpack Pancake Hippos (%s)
plustic.modifier.jetpackpancakehippos.desc: §oTOUCHDOWN!§r\nGrants the user the ability to fly using energy. (Same stats as the jetpack used.) Also grants a bonus to durability.
plustic.modifier.haorans_cult_armor.desc: §oHarry, harry on the wall, who's the hairiest of them all?§r\nWhen withered, reduces HP of all mobs in a certain range by 30% every second.
plustic.modifier.tom_and_jerry_armor.name: Tom and Jerry
plustic.modifier.tom_and_jerry_armor.desc: §o[laughs in flattening Tom]§r\nExplosions caused by a user with this trait slow down those affected.
plustic.modifier.im_a_superstar.name: I'm a Superstar
plustic.modifier.im_a_superstar.desc: §oI am a superstar!…[falls into the toilet]§r\nEffects depend on the player's attunement.
plustic.modifier.autorepair.desc: §oHandy!§r\nWhen the tool breaks, a sharpening kit is grabbed from your inventory to repair it. If the tool is unbreakable, gain 1 modifier instead.
